example_translation: 公司今年在新技术上进行了大量投资。

source_meaning: n. 律师

example_translation: 律师出示了强有力的证据来支持她当事人的案件。

source_meaning: n. 军队, 陆军

example_translation: 军队被派去协助救灾工作。

source_meaning: vt. 遭受, 经历, 忍受；vi. 受痛苦, 受损害

example_translation: 现代社会许多人承受着压力。

source_meaning: a. 早先的, 前面的, 过急的

example_translation: 在上一章中，我们讨论了战争的原因。

source_meaning: vt. 维持, 维修, 保持, 坚持, 供养, 主张

example_translation: 保持健康饮食和定期锻炼很重要。

source_meaning: n. 教授

example_translation: 教授在讲堂里向学生们解释了复杂的理论。

source_meaning: n. 犯罪, 罪行, 罪恶
example: The police are working hard to reduce crime in the city center.
example_translation: 警方正在努力减少市中心的犯罪。

source_meaning: vt. 出版, 发行, 公开, 发表, 宣传, 公布；vi. 出版, 发行

example_translation: 公司计划下个月出版一本关于现代艺术的新书。

source_meaning: n. 法国

example_translation: 法国以葡萄酒、奶酪和美丽的建筑而闻名。

source_meaning: n. 责任, 职责, 负担, 可靠性

example_translation: 对自己的行为负责是成熟的标志。

source_meaning: a. 全体的, 总的, 全然的；vt. 计算...的总和, 共计为；vi. 合计；n. 总数, 全体, 合计；adv. 统统

example_translation: 这次旅行的总费用比我们预期的要高得多。

source_meaning: n. 争论, 论证, 论据, 自变量

example_translation: 他们为今晚看哪部电影激烈争论。

source_meaning: adv. 无论如何, 至少

example_translation: 虽然下雨了，但我们还是去了公园。

source_meaning: vt. 避免, 防止, 撤消

example_translation: 为了保持健康，你应该避免吃太多糖。

source_meaning: n. 帐单, 清单, 钞票, 鸟嘴, 广告, 法案, 票据；vt. 开帐单, (用招贴)宣布

example_translation: 请在本月底前支付电费账单。

source_meaning: n. 最佳部分, 初期, 全盛期；a. 主要的, 最初的, 根本的；v. 加油启动, 灌注, 填装
example: The prime minister will address the nation on television tonight.
example_translation: 首相今晚将在电视上向全国发表讲话。

source_meaning: n. 快车, 快递, 专使；a. 明确的, 丝毫不差的, 专门的, 快的；vt. 表达, 表示, 表露

example_translation: 她乘坐快车去北京，以便为会议节省时间。

source_meaning: n. 枪

example_translation: 士兵在训练演习中携带了一把枪。

source_meaning: vt. 推想, 假设, 以为, 想像, 假定；vi. 料想
example: I suppose you are tired after such a long journey.
example_translation: 我想经过这么长的旅程你一定累了。

source_meaning: n. 元件, 元素, 要素

example_translation: 水是所有生物的基本要素。

source_meaning: n. 战略, 策略

example_translation: 公司制定了新策略以增加市场份额。

source_meaning: n. 责任, 关税, 职务, 尊敬

example_translation: 向警方报告任何可疑活动是你的职责。

source_meaning: vi. 走向, 有某种的倾向, 易于, 照顾, 注意；vt. 照料, 护理

example_translation: 人们在压力大时往往吃得更多。

source_meaning: n. 事实, 实情

example_translation: 事故的真相在多年沉默后终于浮出水面。

source_meaning: a. 民主的

example_translation: 在民主社会中，公民有自由投票的权利。

source_meaning: adv. 突然, 意外, 忽然, 迅速, 即席作成, 即刻, 急速
example: The lights went out suddenly, leaving the room in complete darkness.
example_translation: 灯突然熄灭了，房间里一片漆黑。

source_meaning: n. 头衔, 名称, 标题, 书名, 扉页, 权利, 资格, 冠军, 字幕；vt. 授予头衔, 加标题于
example: She read the title of the book before deciding to buy it.
example_translation: 她先看了书名，然后决定买下它。

source_meaning: n. 宴请, 款待；vt. 视为, 对待, 论述, 治疗, 款待；vi. 讨论, 谈判, 作东

example_translation: 医生将用一种新药治疗这位病人。

source_meaning: adv. 到处, 贯穿全部地, 自始至终；prep. 遍及, 在各处
example: The company has offices throughout the world.
example_translation: 这家公司在世界各地都有办事处。

source_meaning: n. 讨论
example: We had a long discussion about the project's future.
example_translation: 我们就项目的未来进行了长时间的讨论。

source_meaning: adv. 通常, 逐渐地, 普遍地

example_translation: 一般来说，人们更喜欢在舒适的环境中工作。

source_meaning: n. 外观, 方面, 面貌, 方向

example_translation: 这份工作的一个重要方面是与客户打交道。

source_meaning: n. 执行部门, 执行委员会, 执行者, 经理主管人员；a. 执行的, 善于执行的, 善于经营的

example_translation: 管理团队决定扩大业务。

source_meaning: a. 工业的, 供工业用的, 工业高度发展的, 产业的；n. 工业工人, 工业股票
example: The industrial revolution changed the way people lived and worked.
example_translation: 工业革命改变了人们的生活和工作方式。

source_meaning: n. 主席, 会长

example_translation: 主席以简短的讲话开始了会议。

source_meaning: vt. 移动, 调动, 除去, 迁移, 开除, 移交；vi. 迁移, 移动, 搬家；n. 班级, 升级, 移动, 搬家, 间距

example_translation: 进屋前请脱鞋。

source_meaning: n. 悬挂, 诀窍, 意义；vt. 悬挂, 附着, 装饰, 垂下, 踌躇, 绞死, 使悬而未决；vi. 悬着, 垂下, 被绞死, 悬而不决
example: She decided to hang the picture on the wall.
example_translation: 她决定把画挂在墙上。

source_meaning: n. 整个, 全部；a. 全体的, 完全的, 全部的
example: She spent the entire afternoon reading a novel in the park.
example_translation: 她在公园里花了整个下午读一本小说。

source_meaning: n. 岩石, 岩礁, 石头, 基石, 暗礁, 摇动, 摇滚乐；vt. 摇摆, 摇动, 使摇晃, 使动摇；vi. 摇, 摇动

example_translation: 孩子们爬过海滩附近的大岩石。

source_meaning: vi. 存在, 生存, 发生

example_translation: 许多动物物种只存在于偏远地区。

source_meaning: n. 消费者

example_translation: 顾客因产品损坏而要求退款。

source_meaning: n. 机构, 惯例, 制度

example_translation: 这所大学是著名的教育机构。

source_meaning: vt. 鼓励, 支持, 激励
example: Teachers should encourage students to ask questions in class.
example_translation: 老师应该鼓励学生在课堂上提问。

source_meaning: n. 网络, 广播网, 网状物

example_translation: 这家公司在全国拥有广泛的供应商网络。

source_meaning: n. 特效药, 特性；a. 特殊的, 明确的, 具有特效的, 特定地, 具体地

example_translation: 老师对作业给出了具体的指示。

source_meaning: a. 适当的

example_translation: 今晚的正式晚宴请穿合适的衣服。

source_meaning: n. 利润, 赢利, 利益；vi. 有益, 获利, 赚钱；vt. 有益于
example: The company made a large profit from selling its new software.
example_translation: 这家公司通过销售新软件获得了巨额利润。

source_meaning: n. 感冒, 寒冷；a. 寒冷的, 冷淡的, 冷静的；adv. 完全地

example_translation: 她感冒了，不得不在床上躺了两天。

source_meaning: vt. 反射, 反映, 招致, 深思；vi. 被反射, 映出, 深思, 考虑, 指责

example_translation: 平静的湖面完美地映出了五彩斑斓的秋树。

source_meaning: vt. 假定, 承担, 呈现；vi. 装腔作势, 僭越

example_translation: 我假设你在会议前已经读过这份报告了。

source_meaning: vt. 承认, 接受, 允许进入, 容许；vi. 开向, 容许, 承认

example_translation: 她不得不承认自己在报告中犯了一个严重的错误。

source_meaning: n. 石头, 宝石, 果核, 纪念碑, 结石；vt. 投扔石子, 铺石头；a. 石的, 石制的, 完全的

example_translation: 这座古桥完全由石头建成，已经屹立了几个世纪。

source_meaning: n. 尺寸, 量度器, 量度标准, 测量, 量具, 程度, 范围, 限度, 分寸, 措施, 方法；vt. 测量, 测度, 估量, 权衡, 调节, 拿(自己或自己的力量等)作较量；vi. 度量

example_translation: 买家具前我们需要测量房间的长度。

source_meaning: n. 会议

example_translation: 她将在下个月的国际会议上展示她的研究。

source_meaning: n. 分, 分开, 除法, 部门(如部、处、系等), 师

example_translation: 公司的销售部门报告收入显著增长。

source_meaning: n. 记忆, 记忆力, 回忆, 纪念, 存储；n. 内存

example_translation: 他最早的记忆是和妹妹在花园里玩耍。

source_meaning: vt. 代替, 替换, 放回, 归还

example_translation: 你应该用新电池替换旧电池。

source_meaning: n. 程序, 过程, 手续

example_translation: 启动机器前必须遵守安全程序。

source_meaning: n. 委任状, 任官令, 所委职责, 佣金, 犯, 委托, 所托之事；vt. 委任, 委托制作, 使服役

example_translation: 这位艺术家接到委托为市长画一幅肖像。

source_meaning: n. 审判, 试验, 艰苦, 麻烦事, 考验；a. 审讯的, 试验性的

example_translation: 这种新药经过了临床试验，以测试其在患者身上的安全性和有效性。

source_meaning: n. 专家, 行家；a. 老练的, 内行的, 专门的

example_translation: 专家对经济形势进行了详细分析。

source_meaning: n. 提议, 计划, 求婚

example_translation: 委员会否决了修建新公路的提议。

source_meaning: conj. 除非；prep. 除...之外

example_translation: 除非你努力学习，否则考试不会及格。

source_meaning: vt. 改良, 提高...的价值, 改善, 利用；vi. 变得更好, 增加
example: Regular exercise can improve your overall health and mood.
example_translation: 定期锻炼可以改善你的整体健康和情绪。

source_meaning: n. 环境, 状况, 事件

example_translation: 在任何情况下你都不应该向任何人透露你的密码，即使是亲密的朋友。

collocations.meaning: 决不，在任何情况下都不

collocations.meaning: 由于我们无法控制的情况

word_family.meaning: 依情况而定的；间接的（证据）

source_meaning: vt. 想像, 设想, 猜测；vi. 想像起来

example_translation: 你能想象生活在一个没有任何技术的世界吗？

source_meaning: n. 方向, 指导, 趋势

example_translation: 老师就如何完成科学项目给出了明确的指导。

source_meaning: n. 基本原理, 要素, 基本规律；a. 基本的, 碱性的；(计算机)BASIC语言

example_translation: 理解基础数学对日常生活至关重要。

source_meaning: a. 极大的, 巨大的, 无限的

example_translation: 新购物中心是一座巨大的建筑，里面有很多商店。

source_meaning: n. 代表会议, 苏维埃, 苏联；a. 苏维埃的, 苏联的

example_translation: 苏联在二十世纪是一个大国。

source_meaning: vt. 计划, 打算, 意思是

example_translation: 我打算今晚晚饭前完成作业。

source_meaning: a. 最初的, 原始的, 有创意的；n. 原物, 原作
example: The original painting is displayed in the national museum.
example_translation: 这幅原作陈列在国家博物馆里。

source_meaning: n. 冲击, 冲突, 影响, 效果；vt. 挤入, 撞击, 压紧, 对...发生影响
example: The new policy had a significant impact on the economy.
example_translation: 新政策对经济产生了重大影响。

source_meaning: n. 态度, 看法, 姿势
example: She has a positive attitude towards learning new languages.
example_translation: 她对学习新语言持积极态度。

source_meaning: vt. 以...回答；vi. 回答, 响应, 回报, 有反应, 承担责任

example_translation: 请尽快回复我的邮件。

source_meaning: a. 知道的, 有觉悟的

example_translation: 你意识到这项活动涉及的风险了吗？

source_meaning: vt. 发现, 找到, 暴露；vi. 发现

example_translation: 科学家希望发现治疗这种疾病的新方法。

source_meaning: a. 通俗的, 流行的, 受欢迎的, 大众的, 人民的, 普及的

example_translation: 这首歌在年轻人中很受欢迎。

source_meaning: a. 传统的, 惯例的

example_translation: 他们用传统音乐和舞蹈庆祝节日。

source_meaning: prep. 在...之上

example_translation: 猫跳到桌子上，打翻了一个杯子。

source_meaning: vt. 露出, 显示, 透露, 揭露, 泄露, (神)启示；n. 窗侧, 门侧

example_translation: 调查将揭示事故的真正原因。

source_meaning: n. 德国

example_translation: 德国以其丰富的历史和美丽的风景而闻名。

source_meaning: n. 武器, 兵器；vt. 武装

example_translation: 士兵在任务开始前仔细擦拭了他的武器。

source_meaning: n. 职员, 员工, 受雇人员

example_translation: 公司为每位新员工提供培训项目。

source_meaning: n. 雇用, 职业, 工作

example_translation: 找到稳定的工作是许多毕业生的主要目标。

example_translation: 经过多年的冲突，两国终于签署了和平条约。

source_meaning: vt. 拒绝, 谢绝；vi. 拒绝；n. 废物；a. 扔掉的, 无用的

example_translation: 她不得不拒绝邀请，因为她太忙了。

source_meaning: n. 痛苦, 疼痛, 辛苦；vt. 使痛苦, 痛苦；vi. 作痛, 疼

example_translation: 跑上楼梯后，他感到胸口一阵剧痛。

source_meaning: v. 预防, 防止, 阻止, 妨碍

example_translation: 经常锻炼有助于预防许多常见疾病。

example_translation: 政府正在调查涉及几名官员的财务事件。

source_meaning: n. 恳求, 诉请, 上诉, 吸引力；vi. 呼吁, 诉请, 要求, 上诉, 有吸引力；vt. 将...上诉

example_translation: 这次慈善呼吁为洪水灾民筹集了一百多万美元。

example_translation: 地震使整栋建筑剧烈摇晃了几秒钟。

source_meaning: n. 面谈, 访问, 接见, 面试；vt. 接见, 对...进行面谈(试)

example_translation: 她为科技公司的求职面试做了精心准备。

source_meaning: n. 关心, 注意, 尊敬, 关系, 问候；vt. 视为, 注意, 考虑, 和...有关, 看待；vi. 注视, 注意

example_translation: 在做决定之前，请慎重考虑这件事。

example_translation: 孩子们在游戏中试图躲在门后。

example_translation: 这艘船装载了货物，准备远航。

source_meaning: n. 雾, 迷惑, (割后的)最生草, 苔藓；vi. 被雾笼罩, 变模糊；vt. 使困惑, 以雾笼罩

example_translation: 她决定在夏季聚会前修剪花园里长得过密的灌木。

example_translation: 冗长的讲座开始让学生们感到厌烦，他们努力保持清醒。

example_translation: 船在平静的港口抛锚过夜。

example_translation: 他是个骗子，所以没人再相信他的承诺。

source_meaning: n. 女士, 夫人
example: Madam, your table is ready by the window.
example_translation: 女士，您的靠窗座位已经准备好了。

source_meaning: n. 背心, 汗背心；vt. 使穿衣服, 授予；vi. 穿衣服, 归属
example: He wore a bulletproof vest under his jacket during the security operation.
example_translation: 在安全行动中，他在夹克里面穿了一件防弹背心。

source_meaning: n. 振动, 颤动
example: The vibration from the washing machine shook the floor.
example_translation: 洗衣机的震动使地板晃动。

source_meaning: n. 电车轨道, 煤车, 纬纱, 纬丝；vt. 用煤车运载；vi. 乘电车
example: The tram runs through the city center every ten minutes.
example_translation: 电车每十分钟穿过市中心一次。

source_meaning: n. 手帕, 头巾, 围巾
example: She wiped her tears with a silk handkerchief.
example_translation: 她用一条丝质手帕擦去眼泪。

source_meaning: n. 拍手, 拍手声, 霹雳声, 花柳病；v. 鼓掌, (使)啪地关上
example: The audience began to clap enthusiastically as the singer finished her final song.
example_translation: 当歌手唱完最后一首歌时，观众开始热情地鼓掌。

source_meaning: a. 放射性的, 有放射能的
example: The workers wore protective suits to handle radioactive materials.
example_translation: 工人们穿着防护服处理放射性物质。

source_meaning: vt. 克服, 征服, 战胜；vi. 得胜
example: The army managed to conquer the enemy's fortress after a long siege.
example_translation: 经过长期围困，军队成功攻克了敌人的堡垒。

source_meaning: a. 疲倦的, 萎靡的, 厌倦的, 厌烦的；vt. 使疲倦, 使厌烦；vi. 疲乏, 生厌, 不耐烦
example: After the long journey, the travelers felt weary and wanted to rest.
example_translation: 长途旅行后，旅客们感到疲倦，想要休息。

source_meaning: v. 哀悼, 忧伤, 服丧
example: The whole community gathered to mourn the loss of their beloved teacher.
example_translation: 整个社区聚集在一起，哀悼他们敬爱的老师的去世。

source_meaning: a. 难得的, 稀罕的, 缺乏的
example: Fresh water is scarce in many parts of the world, so we must use it wisely.
example_translation: 世界上许多地方淡水稀缺，所以我们必须明智地使用它。

source_meaning: vt. 刺穿, 穿透, 打眼于, 洞悉, (声音)响彻, (亮光)照进, 深深地打动；vi. 刺入, 穿入, 透入, 进入
example: The needle will pierce the fabric easily if it is sharp enough.
example_translation: 如果针足够锋利，就能轻松刺穿布料。

source_meaning: n. 更坏的事, 更恶劣的事, 败局；a. 更坏的, 更恶劣的；adv. 更坏地, 更恶劣地
example: The weather got worse as the storm approached the coast.
example_translation: 随着风暴逼近海岸，天气变得更糟了。

source_meaning: adv. 预先
example: Please let me know beforehand if you plan to visit us this weekend.
example_translation: 如果你计划这周末来访，请提前告诉我。

source_meaning: n. 梨子, 梨树, 梨木
example: She sliced a ripe pear and added it to the fruit salad.
example_translation: 她切了一个熟梨，加进了水果沙拉里。

source_meaning: n. 勇气, 猛拉, 动物内脏；vt. 摘, 猛拉, 拔, 拉, 扯, 采；vi. 拉, 拽
example: She had to pluck the feathers from the chicken before cooking it.
example_translation: 她得在烹饪前把鸡毛拔掉。

source_meaning: a. 阴历的, 月的, 微亮的(指光)
example: The lunar eclipse was visible from many parts of the world last night.
example_translation: 昨晚世界上许多地方都能看到月食。

source_meaning: a. 诚实的, 正直的, 真挚的, 纯净的
example: She offered a sincere apology for arriving late to the meeting.
example_translation: 她为开会迟到而真诚地道歉。

source_meaning: n. 一条面包, 块, 游荡；v. 游手好闲, 虚度光阴
example: He bought a fresh loaf of bread from the bakery this morning.
example_translation: 他今天早上从面包店买了一条新鲜面包。

source_meaning: n. 守候, 侦察, 搜索, 侦察员, 侦察机；vi. 守候, 侦察, 巡视, 嘲笑；vt. 侦察, 跟踪, 发现, 监视, 嘲弄
example: The scout reported the enemy's position to the commander.
example_translation: 侦察兵向指挥官报告了敌人的位置。

source_meaning: n. 母猪, 懒胖女人；vt. 播种, 散布, 使密布；vi. 播种
example: Farmers sow seeds in the spring and harvest in the autumn.
example_translation: 农民春天播种，秋天收获。

source_meaning: a. 成功的, 繁盛的, 幸运的
example: The prosperous city attracted many investors from around the world.
example_translation: 这座繁荣的城市吸引了来自世界各地的许多投资者。

source_meaning: n. 松鼠, 松鼠毛皮；vt. 贮藏
example: The squirrel gathered nuts and stored them in the hollow tree.
example_translation: 松鼠收集坚果并把它们储存在空树干里。

source_meaning: n. 犁, 犁过的地；vi. 用犁耕田, 开路；vt. 耕, 犁, 开路
example: The farmer used a tractor to plough the field before planting.
example_translation: 农民在种植前用拖拉机犁地。

source_meaning: v. 欺骗, 行骗
example: He tried to deceive the customers with false advertising claims.
example_translation: 他试图用虚假的广告宣传来欺骗顾客。

source_meaning: a. 意外的, 偶然的, 非主要的, 附属的；n. 临时记号, 次要方面
example: The fire was caused by an accidental spark from the machine.
example_translation: 火灾是由机器意外迸出的火花引起的。

source_meaning: n. 失事, 残骸, 破坏；vt. 使失事, 拆毁, 破坏；vi. (船)失事, 营救失事船只
example: The storm left the old ship a complete wreck on the rocky shore.
example_translation: 暴风雨使那艘旧船在岩石海岸上彻底残破不堪。

collocations.meaning: 火车失事；彻底失败的局面

source_meaning: n. 杠杆, 似杠杆之工具；vt. 撬开；vi. 使用杠杆
example: He used a long lever to lift the heavy stone.
example_translation: 他用一根长杠杆撬起了那块重石头。

source_meaning: n. 饥荒, 缺乏, 饥饿
example: The prolonged drought caused a severe famine in the region.
example_translation: 长期干旱导致该地区发生严重饥荒。

source_meaning: a. 无知识的, 不知道的, 由无知产生的
example: He was ignorant of the rules and made many mistakes.
example_translation: 他对规则一无所知，犯了很多错误。

source_meaning: n. 爪, 螯, 抓伤；v. 用爪抓, 挖, 搜刮
example: The cat used its sharp claw to scratch the wooden door.
example_translation: 猫用锋利的爪子抓挠木门。

source_meaning: n. 霜, 冰冻, 冷漠；vt. 覆着霜, 冻结, 结霜；vi. 受冻, 起霜
example: The morning frost covered the grass and made it sparkle in the sunlight.
example_translation: 早晨的霜覆盖了草地，在阳光下闪闪发光。

source_meaning: a. 令人惊异的, 了不起的, 不平常的
example: The magician performed a marvelous trick that amazed the entire audience.
example_translation: 魔术师表演了一个令所有观众惊叹的奇妙戏法。

source_meaning: n. 水银, 汞, 使者
example: Mercury is a heavy metal that is liquid at room temperature.
example_translation: 汞是一种在室温下呈液态的重金属。

source_meaning: n. 锯子, 谚语；vt. 锯, 锯开, 来回移动；vi. 拉锯, 移动；see的过去式
example: He used a saw to cut the wooden board into two pieces.
example_translation: 他用锯子把木板锯成两半。

source_meaning: n. 国际象棋
example: My grandfather taught me how to play chess when I was young.
example_translation: 我祖父在我小时候教我下国际象棋。

source_meaning: n. 骆驼, 打捞浮筒
example: The camel walked slowly across the hot desert carrying heavy loads.
example_translation: 骆驼驮着重物缓慢地穿过炎热的沙漠。

source_meaning: n. 辞别, 再见, 再会；interj. 再会
example: They held a farewell party for their colleague who was moving abroad.
example_translation: 他们为即将移居国外的同事举办了欢送会。

source_meaning: vt. 抵住, 顶住, 经得起
example: The bridge was designed to withstand strong earthquakes and heavy winds.
example_translation: 这座桥的设计能够承受强烈地震和强风。

source_meaning: a. 不稳定的
example: The political situation in the region remains unstable and unpredictable.
example_translation: 该地区的政治局势仍然不稳定且难以预测。

source_meaning: n. 缰绳, 统治, 支配；vt. 驾驭, 以缰绳控制, 控制；vi. 勒住马
example: The rider pulled the rein to stop the horse at the gate.
example_translation: 骑手拉紧缰绳让马在门口停下。

source_meaning: n. 卷心菜
example: She chopped the cabbage and added it to the soup for dinner.
example_translation: 她把卷心菜切碎，加入晚餐的汤里。

source_meaning: n. 木材, 破旧家俱, 废物, 隆隆声；vt. 砍伐木材, 乱堆；vi. 笨拙地移动, 喧闹地向前走, 隆隆地移动
example: The workers loaded the lumber onto the truck for transportation.
example_translation: 工人们把木材装上卡车以便运输。

source_meaning: a. 抑沉的, 忧闷的, 黑暗的, 悲观的
example: The gloomy weather made everyone feel tired and depressed.
example_translation: 阴沉的天气让每个人都感到疲惫和沮丧。

source_meaning: a. 自私的, 利己主义的, 自我中心的
example: Being selfish is not a good quality for a team member.
example_translation: 自私不是团队成员的好品质。

source_meaning: n. 定金, 诚挚, 认真；a. 认真的, 热心的, 重要的
example: She made an earnest effort to improve her English skills every day.
example_translation: 她每天认真努力地提高英语水平。

source_meaning: n. 不规则物, 不合规格之物；a. 不规则的, 不整齐的, 不合法的
example: The irregular shape of the rock made it difficult to fit into the puzzle.
example_translation: 岩石不规则的形状使其难以嵌入拼图。

source_meaning: n. 洞, 窟窿, 山谷；a. 空的, 虚伪的, 空腹的, 凹的；vi. 形成空洞；vt. 挖空
example: The hollow tree trunk provided a safe shelter for the small animals.
example_translation: 中空的树干为小动物提供了安全的庇护所。

source_meaning: a. 粗糙的, 下等的, 粗俗的
example: The coarse sand on the beach hurt my feet as I walked.
example_translation: 海滩上粗糙的沙子让我走路时脚疼。

source_meaning: n. 野兔；vi. 飞跑
example: The hare ran quickly across the field to escape the hunter.
example_translation: 野兔飞快地跑过田野以躲避猎人。

source_meaning: n. 驴子, 笨蛋, 顽固者, 辅助发动机, 辅助泵
example: The farmer loaded the heavy sacks onto the donkey before heading to the market.
example_translation: 农夫在去市场之前把沉重的麻袋装到驴背上。

collocations.meaning: 单调乏味的工作；苦差事

source_meaning: n. 东方人, 亚洲人；a. 东方诸国的, 亚洲的, 东方的
example: She has always been fascinated by oriental art and its rich cultural history.
example_translation: 她一直对东方艺术及其丰富的文化历史着迷。

source_meaning: n. 工人, 工匠, 男工
example: The workman repaired the broken roof in just two hours.
example_translation: 工人仅用两小时就修好了破损的屋顶。

source_meaning: a. 不正确的
example: The answer you gave in the test was incorrect, so you lost two points.
example_translation: 你在考试中给出的答案不正确，因此扣了两分。

source_meaning: n. 指南针, 范围, 音域；vt. 包围, 达到, 图谋, 理解
example: The sailor used a compass to find his way across the vast ocean.
example_translation: 水手用指南针在广阔的海洋上辨别方向。

source_meaning: n. 初学者
example: As a beginner in painting, she started with simple watercolor exercises.
example_translation: 作为绘画初学者，她从简单的水彩练习开始。

source_meaning: n. 水壶, 军中俱乐部, 临时流动餐馆, 小卖部
example: The workers had lunch at the factory canteen every day.
example_translation: 工人们每天在工厂食堂吃午饭。

source_meaning: n. 加速, 促进, 加速度
example: The acceleration of the car impressed everyone during the test drive.
example_translation: 试驾时汽车的加速性能给所有人留下了深刻印象。

source_meaning: vt. 单一化, 简单化
example: The teacher tried to simplify the complex theory for her students.
example_translation: 老师试图为学生们简化这个复杂的理论。

source_meaning: n. 自助餐厅
example: The cafeteria offers a variety of dishes at reasonable prices for students.
example_translation: 自助餐厅为学生提供各种价格合理的菜肴。

source_meaning: a. 不安静的, 慌张的, 休息不充分的
example: The restless child could not sit still during the long meeting.
example_translation: 那个不安分的孩子在漫长的会议中坐不住。

source_meaning: vt. 铺设, 安排, 铺满, 为...铺路
example: The city plans to pave the old dirt road with asphalt next month.
example_translation: 城市计划下个月用沥青铺设这条旧土路。

source_meaning: n. 油炸食物, 鱼苗；v. 油炸, 煎
example: She decided to fry the fish in a little olive oil for dinner.
example_translation: 她决定晚餐用少许橄榄油煎鱼。

source_meaning: n. 滑动, 滑过, 流水；vi. 滑动, 滑翔, 溜走, 流逝；vt. 使滑动
example: The eagle began to glide gracefully over the mountain valley.
example_translation: 鹰开始优雅地滑翔在山谷上空。

source_meaning: n. 半径, 范围, 辐射光线
example: The explosion affected everything within a radius of five kilometers.
example_translation: 爆炸影响了五公里半径内的一切。

source_meaning: n. 火焰, 烈火, 光辉；vi. 燃烧, 发光；vt. 使燃烧, 宣布, 在树皮上刻痕
example: The firemen quickly extinguished the blaze before it spread to nearby houses.
example_translation: 消防员迅速扑灭了大火，防止它蔓延到附近的房屋。

source_meaning: n. 尼龙
example: The backpack is made of durable nylon that resists water and tears.
example_translation: 这个背包由耐用的尼龙制成，防水且抗撕裂。

source_meaning: n. 大炮, 加农炮；v. 炮轰
example: The old cannon on the hill was fired during the historical reenactment.
example_translation: 山上的旧大炮在历史重演活动中被发射了。

source_meaning: vt. 使困窘, 使局促不安, 阻碍
example: His careless remark about her weight embarrassed her in front of everyone.
example_translation: 他关于她体重的无心之言使她在众人面前感到困窘。

source_meaning: pron. 自己, 亲自
example: One should always be true to oneself and follow one's own beliefs.
example_translation: 一个人应该始终忠于自己，并遵循自己的信念。

source_meaning: vt. 拴紧, 使固定, 系, 集中于, 强加于；vi. 扣紧
example: Please fasten your seatbelt before the plane takes off.
example_translation: 飞机起飞前请系好安全带。

source_meaning: n. 航行, 航海, 导航
example: The navigation system guided us through the busy city streets.
example_translation: 导航系统引导我们穿过了繁忙的城市街道。

source_meaning: n. 行李, 皮箱
example: Please put your luggage in the overhead compartment.
example_translation: 请把行李放在头顶的行李架上。

source_meaning: a. 丰富的, 富裕的；n. 支流, 富人
example: The affluent neighborhood is known for its luxurious houses.
example_translation: 这个富裕的社区以其豪华的住宅而闻名。

source_meaning: a. 顽皮的, 没规矩的, 不适当的, 下流的
example: The naughty boy hid his teacher's chalk.
example_translation: 那个淘气的男孩藏起了老师的粉笔。

source_meaning: n. 方言, 同源语
example: She speaks a dialect of Chinese that is hard to understand.
example_translation: 她说一种很难懂的中文方言。

source_meaning: vt. 推论出, 推断；vi. 作推论
example: From the evidence, we can infer that the suspect was lying.
example_translation: 从证据中，我们可以推断嫌疑人是在撒谎。

source_meaning: n. 恶习, 恶行, 罪恶, 堕落, 缺陷, 恶癖, 老虎钳；vt. 钳住；prep. 代替
example: Smoking is a vice that many people find hard to quit.
example_translation: 吸烟是一种许多人难以戒掉的恶习。

source_meaning: n. 薄暮, 傍晚, 黄昏；a. 微暗的；v. (使)微暗
example: The park is especially beautiful at dusk when the sky turns orange.
example_translation: 黄昏时分，天空变成橙色，公园格外美丽。

source_meaning: n. 芦苇, 芦笛, 簧舌, 纤弱的人；vt. 用芦苇盖, 用小凸嵌线装饰
example: The musician played a soft melody on his reed instrument during the concert.
example_translation: 音乐家在音乐会上用他的簧管乐器演奏了一首柔和的旋律。

source_meaning: n. 蜡, 蜡状物, 一阵发怒, 增加, (月亮)渐盈；vi. 变大, 增大, 月亮渐满；vt. 上蜡于
example: The moon waxes and wanes in a cycle that lasts about twenty-nine days.
example_translation: 月亮在一个大约持续二十九天的周期中渐盈和渐亏。

source_meaning: a. 优美的
example: The ballet dancer made a graceful leap across the stage.
example_translation: 芭蕾舞演员在舞台上做了一个优雅的跳跃。

source_meaning: n. 傀儡, 木偶
example: The children watched a puppet show about a brave knight.
example_translation: 孩子们观看了一场关于勇敢骑士的木偶戏。

source_meaning: n. 胶, 粘性物；vt. 粘合, 胶合
example: Use strong glue to fix the broken vase.
example_translation: 用强力胶把破碎的花瓶粘好。

source_meaning: n. 显微镜
example: The scientist examined the cell under a powerful microscope.
example_translation: 科学家在强大的显微镜下检查细胞。

source_meaning: n. 涡轮机
example: The wind turbine generates electricity for the whole village.
example_translation: 风力涡轮机为整个村庄发电。

source_meaning: n. 面纱, 面罩, 借口, 幕, 帐, 遮蔽物；vt. 戴面纱, 隐藏, 遮蔽, 掩饰；vi. 蒙上面纱
example: The bride wore a white veil over her face.
example_translation: 新娘脸上蒙着白色的面纱。

source_meaning: n. 日出, 黎明, 拂晓
example: We woke up early to watch the beautiful sunrise over the ocean.
example_translation: 我们早早起床，去看海面上美丽的日出。

source_meaning: n. 头梳, 鸡冠；vt. 梳头发, 梳毛；vi. (浪)涌起
example: She used a comb to style her hair before the interview.
example_translation: 面试前她用梳子整理头发。

source_meaning: n. 摩擦, 摩擦治疗, 不和
example: Friction between the two countries led to a trade war.
example_translation: 两国之间的摩擦导致了贸易战。

source_meaning: n. 孵化, 舱口；vt. 孵, 孵出, 策划；vi. 孵化
example: The chicks will hatch from their eggs in about three weeks.
example_translation: 小鸡大约三周后就会从蛋里孵出来。

source_meaning: n. 地质学, 地质情况
example: She studied geology at university and now works for an oil company.
example_translation: 她在大学学习地质学，现在为一家石油公司工作。

source_meaning: a. 快乐的, 愉快的, 嬉戏作乐的
example: We had a merry time at the party, laughing and dancing all night.

source_meaning: a. 未醉的, 稳重的, 节制的, 严肃的, 不夸大的, 合理的, 朴素的；vt. 使醒酒, 使严肃；vi. 从醉里醒来, 变严肃

example_translation: 事故发生后，他保持清醒，立即呼救。

example_translation: 山谷里肥沃的土壤每年都产出丰富的庄稼。

collocations.meaning: 跛脚鸭（任期将满的官员）

source_meaning: n. 副词
example: In English, an adverb often modifies a verb, an adjective, or another adverb.
example_translation: 在英语中，副词通常修饰动词、形容词或另一个副词。

source_meaning: n. 代数学
example: She struggled with algebra in high school but later became a math teacher.
example_translation: 她高中时在代数上很吃力，但后来成为了一名数学老师。

source_meaning: n. 合金；vt. 将...铸成合金, 减低成色；vi. 合铸
example: Steel is an alloy of iron and carbon, widely used in construction.
example_translation: 钢是铁和碳的合金，广泛用于建筑。

source_meaning: n. 安培
example: The electric current in this circuit is measured in ampere, which is a standard unit.
example_translation: 这个电路中的电流以安培为单位进行测量，安培是一个标准单位。

source_meaning: a. 阿拉伯的, 阿拉伯人的
example: The Arabian horse is known for its endurance and beauty.
example_translation: 阿拉伯马以其耐力和美丽而闻名。

source_meaning: vt. 使惊讶
example: The magician's performance never fails to astonish the audience.
example_translation: 魔术师的表演总是让观众感到惊讶。

source_meaning: a. 耳的, 听觉的, 气氛的, 气味的, 光环的
example: The aural test requires students to listen carefully and answer questions.
example_translation: 听力测试要求学生仔细听并回答问题。

source_meaning: n. 自动化, 自动操作
example: Automation has greatly increased productivity in modern factories.
example_translation: 自动化大大提高了现代工厂的生产率。

source_meaning: n. 辅助者, 辅助物, 附属机构, 助动词；a. 辅助的, 备用的
example: The hospital hired several auxiliary nurses to help during the busy season.
example_translation: 医院在繁忙季节雇佣了几名辅助护士来帮忙。

source_meaning: n. 羽毛球运动
example: They play badminton every weekend at the community sports center.
example_translation: 他们每个周末都在社区体育中心打羽毛球。

source_meaning: n. 胸部, 胸, 胸怀, 内部, 中间；vt. 怀抱
example: She held the letter to her bosom and smiled with joy.
example_translation: 她把信贴在胸前，高兴地笑了。

source_meaning: n. 大树枝
example: The bird perched on a bough of the old oak tree.
example_translation: 那只鸟栖息在老橡树的一根大树枝上。

source_meaning: n. 边, 边缘, (河)边；vt. 注满, 使满溢；vi. 满溢
example: The cup was filled to the brim with hot coffee.
example_translation: 杯子里的热咖啡满到了杯沿。

source_meaning: n. 刚毛, 猪鬃；vi. 直立, 发怒, 充满；vt. 使直立
example: The dog's fur began to bristle when it sensed danger nearby.
example_translation: 狗感觉到附近有危险时，毛都竖了起来。

collocations.meaning: 因愤怒而毛发竖起；怒发冲冠
对批评感到愤怒或抵触

word_family.meaning: 有刚毛的；粗糙的；易怒的

source_meaning: n. 一窝, 一伙；vt. 孵, 沉思
example: The hen sat on her brood of chicks to keep them warm.
example_translation: 母鸡蹲在它的一窝小鸡上给它们保暖。

source_meaning: n. 小溪；vt. 容忍
example: A small brook flows through the meadow behind our house.
example_translation: 一条小溪流过我们屋后的草地。

source_meaning: n. 畜生, 残忍或好色之人；a. 残忍的, 无理性的, 畜生的
example: The brute force of the storm destroyed many houses along the coast.
example_translation: 风暴的蛮力摧毁了沿海许多房屋。

source_meaning: n. 分
example: She found a cent on the sidewalk and picked it up with a smile.
example_translation: 她在人行道上发现了一分钱，微笑着捡了起来。

source_meaning: n. 圆周, 周缘, 胸围
example: The circumference of the earth is about 40,000 kilometers.
example_translation: 地球的周长约为四万公里。

source_meaning: n. 祝贺, 恭喜
example: Please accept my sincere congratulation on your graduation from university.
example_translation: 请接受我对你大学毕业的诚挚祝贺。

source_meaning: n. 兴奋剂, 补品；a. 热忱的, 诚恳的, 有兴奋作用的
example: The host gave us a cordial welcome and invited us to sit down.
example_translation: 主人热情地欢迎我们，并邀请我们坐下。

source_meaning: n. 懦弱的人, 胆小的人
example: The bully called him a coward for refusing to fight, but he knew it was the right choice.
example_translation: 那个恶霸因为他拒绝打架而叫他懦夫，但他知道那是正确的选择。

source_meaning: n. 欺骗, 谎言
example: His deceit was finally exposed when the truth came out.
example_translation: 当真相大白时，他的欺骗最终被揭穿了。

source_meaning: n. 露珠, 露水；vt. (用露水)沾湿；vi. 结露水
example: The grass was wet with morning dew as the sun rose.
example_translation: 太阳升起时，草上沾满了晨露。

source_meaning: n. 听写, 口述, 命令
example: The teacher gave us a dictation to test our spelling.
example_translation: 老师给我们做了一次听写来测试我们的拼写。

source_meaning: a. 勤勉的, 用功的
example: She is a diligent student who always finishes her homework on time.
example_translation: 她是一个勤奋的学生，总是按时完成作业。

source_meaning: vt. 使失去能力, 使残废, (律)使无资格
example: The sudden accident may disable him for life, preventing him from walking again.
example_translation: 那场突如其来的事故可能使他终身残疾，再也无法行走。

source_meaning: v. 使不愉快, 使(人)生气
example: The manager's decision to cancel the project may displease many employees who worked hard on it.
example_translation: 经理取消项目的决定可能会让许多为此努力工作的员工感到不快。

source_meaning: n. 宿舍
example: The students live in a dormitory near the campus.
example_translation: 学生们住在校园附近的宿舍里。

source_meaning: vt. 花费, 消耗, 用光
example: The company will expend a large amount of money on the new project.
example_translation: 公司将在新项目上花费大量资金。

source_meaning: n. 视力, 目力
example: Reading in dim light can damage your eyesight.
example_translation: 在昏暗的光线下阅读会损害你的视力。

source_meaning: a. 气体的, 气态的, 无实质的
example: Water becomes gaseous when it is heated to boiling point.
example_translation: 水加热到沸点时会变成气态。

source_meaning: n. 灿烂, 闪烁, 辉耀；vi. 灿烂, 闪烁, 辉耀
example: The stars glitter in the clear night sky, creating a magical atmosphere.
example_translation: 星星在晴朗的夜空中闪烁，营造出神奇的氛围。

source_meaning: n. 食品商
example: The grocer sells fresh vegetables and fruits every day.
example_translation: 这位食品商每天出售新鲜的蔬菜和水果。

source_meaning: n. 火药
example: Gunpowder was invented in ancient China and changed warfare.
example_translation: 火药是在古代中国发明的，改变了战争方式。

source_meaning: n. 健身房, 体育馆
example: The school gymnasium is open to students after class.
example_translation: 学校的体育馆课后对学生开放。

source_meaning: a. 习惯的, 惯常的, 平常的
example: He is a habitual smoker who finds it hard to quit.
example_translation: 他是个习惯性吸烟者，很难戒掉。

source_meaning: a. 匆匆的, 轻率的, 性怠的
example: Don't make a hasty decision without thinking carefully.
example_translation: 不要不仔细思考就匆忙做决定。

source_meaning: n. 马力
example: This car's engine has two hundred horsepower.
example_translation: 这辆车的发动机有200马力。

source_meaning: a. 潮湿的, 湿润的, 多湿气的
example: The weather is hot and humid in summer here.
example_translation: 这里夏天天气炎热潮湿。

source_meaning: n. 习语, 成语, 惯用语法, 方言
example: Learning a new idiom can be challenging, but it makes your English sound more natural.
example_translation: 学习一个新的习语可能很有挑战性，但它能让你的英语听起来更自然。

word_family.meaning: 符合语言习惯的；地道的

source_meaning: vt. 使移居入境；vi. 移入
example: Many families choose to immigrate to Canada for better job opportunities and a safer life.
example_translation: 许多家庭选择移民到加拿大，以寻求更好的工作机会和更安全的生活。

source_meaning: a. 模糊的, 不确定的, 无限的
example: The meeting has been postponed for an indefinite period, so we don't know when it will happen.
example_translation: 会议被无限期推迟，所以我们不知道何时会举行。

source_meaning: a. 倒转的, 相反的；n. 反向, 反面
example: The inverse of a number is one divided by that number, such as the inverse of 2 is 1/2.
example_translation: 一个数的倒数是1除以该数，例如2的倒数是1/2。

source_meaning: a. 欢喜的, 高兴的, 令人高兴的
example: The children were joyful when they heard the news of the school trip to the beach.
example_translation: 孩子们听到学校要去海滩旅行的消息时非常高兴。

source_meaning: n. 千克, 公斤
example: The package weighs exactly one kilogram, so it can be sent by standard mail.
example_translation: 这个包裹正好重一公斤，所以可以用标准邮件寄送。

source_meaning: n. 女房东, 女地主
example: The landlady was very kind and always helped her tenants with any problems they had.
example_translation: 女房东非常友善，总是帮助她的房客解决他们遇到的任何问题。

source_meaning: n. 扩音器, 喇叭
example: The teacher used a loudspeaker to make her voice heard by all the students in the large hall.
example_translation: 老师用扩音器让大厅里所有的学生都能听到她的声音。

source_meaning: a. 象男人的, 强壮的, 适于男人的
example: He showed a manly courage when he faced the difficult situation without any fear.
example_translation: 他在面对困难局面时表现出男子汉的勇气，毫无畏惧。

source_meaning: n. 唯物主义
example: The philosophy of materialism argues that matter is the fundamental substance of the universe.
example_translation: 唯物主义哲学认为物质是宇宙的基本实体。

word_family.meaning: 唯物主义的；物质主义的

source_meaning: n. 哑子, 哑音字母, 弱音器；a. 哑的, 无声的, 沉默的；vt. 减弱...的声音；vi. 排泄
example: The mute button on the remote control allows you to silence the television instantly.
example_translation: 遥控器上的静音按钮可以让你立即让电视静音。

source_meaning: n. 羊肉
example: The traditional dish is made with tender mutton and fresh vegetables, cooked slowly for hours.
example_translation: 这道传统菜肴用嫩羊肉和新鲜蔬菜制成，慢炖数小时。

source_meaning: n. 黑人；a. 黑人的
example: The term 'negro' is now considered outdated and offensive, so it is rarely used today.
example_translation: “negro”一词现在被认为过时且具有冒犯性，因此今天很少使用。

source_meaning: n. 大洋洲
example: Oceania is a region that includes Australia, New Zealand, and many Pacific islands.
example_translation: 大洋洲是一个包括澳大利亚、新西兰和许多太平洋岛屿的地区。

source_meaning: vt. 压迫, 压抑, 使烦恼
example: The dictator used his power to oppress the people, taking away their basic rights and freedoms.
example_translation: 独裁者利用权力压迫人民，剥夺他们的基本权利和自由。

source_meaning: n. 外套大衣
example: He put on his heavy overcoat before going out into the cold winter wind.
example_translation: 他在出门面对寒冷的冬风之前穿上了厚厚的大衣。

source_meaning: a. 过期的, 未兑的, 迟到的, 早就成熟的
example: The library book is overdue by two weeks, so you will have to pay a fine.
example_translation: 图书馆的书已经逾期两周了，所以你必须支付罚款。

source_meaning: a. 未付的, 亏欠的, 受惠的, 归因于...的
example: Owing to the heavy rain, the outdoor concert was cancelled at the last minute.
example_translation: 由于大雨，户外音乐会在最后一刻被取消了。

source_meaning: n. 牛
example: The farmer used an ox to pull the heavy plow through the muddy field.
example_translation: 农民用一头牛拉着沉重的犁穿过泥泞的田地。

source_meaning: n. 大熊猫, 小熊猫
example: The giant panda is a beloved symbol of wildlife conservation efforts in China.
example_translation: 大熊猫是中国野生动物保护工作中深受喜爱的象征。

source_meaning: n. 消遣, 娱乐, 游戏
example: Reading is my favorite pastime on a rainy afternoon.
example_translation: 阅读是我雨天下午最喜欢的消遣。

source_meaning: n. 复数；a. 复数的, 两个以上的
example: The plural form of 'child' is 'children'.
example_translation: 'child' 的复数形式是 'children'。

source_meaning: n. 前置词, 介词
example: In the sentence 'The book is on the table,' the word 'on' is a preposition.
example_translation: 在句子'The book is on the table'中，单词'on'是一个介词。

source_meaning: a. 准时的, 守时的, 点状的, 中肯的
example: She is always punctual for her morning classes.
example_translation: 她上早课总是很准时。

source_meaning: vi. 变纯净；vt. 使纯净, 净化, 提纯, 精炼
example: The new filter can purify the water in the tank.
example_translation: 新过滤器可以净化水箱里的水。

source_meaning: n. 夸脱
example: She bought a quart of milk from the store.
example_translation: 她从商店买了一夸脱牛奶。

source_meaning: n. 怪人, 同性恋者；a. 奇怪的, 不舒服的, 可疑的；vt. 搞糟
example: He felt queer after eating the strange food.
example_translation: 吃了奇怪的食物后，他感到不舒服。

source_meaning: n. 放射性
example: The lab measures the radioactivity of the sample daily.
example_translation: 实验室每天测量样品的放射性。

source_meaning: n. 小萝卜
example: She added sliced radish to the salad for a crunchy texture.
example_translation: 她在沙拉里加了切片小萝卜，以增加脆爽口感。

source_meaning: n. 镭
example: Marie Curie discovered radium, a highly radioactive element.
example_translation: 居里夫人发现了镭，一种高放射性元素。

source_meaning: vt. 回忆, 回想, 忆起；vi. 回忆
example: I can recollect the exact moment we first met.
example_translation: 我能回忆起我们第一次见面的确切时刻。

source_meaning: vt. 使清新, 使恢复, 使生气蓬勃；vi. 提起精神, 恢复精神, 吃点心, 喝饮料；vt. 刷新, 重新整理；vi. 刷新, 重新整理
example: A short nap will refresh you before the meeting.
example_translation: 会前小睡片刻会让你精神焕发。

source_meaning: vt. 反驳, 驳斥；驳倒
example: The scientist presented new evidence to refute the popular theory about climate change.
example_translation: 这位科学家提出了新证据来驳斥关于气候变化的流行理论。

source_meaning: vi. 后悔, 懊悔, 忏悔；vt. 后悔；a. 匍匐生根的
example: He began to repent of his hasty decision after seeing the consequences.
example_translation: 看到后果后，他开始后悔自己草率的决定。

source_meaning: n. 责备, 耻辱；vt. 责备, 申斥, 使丢脸
example: His behavior brought reproach upon the whole family, and he felt deeply ashamed.
example_translation: 他的行为给全家带来了耻辱，他深感羞愧。

source_meaning: n. 谜, 谜语, 粗筛；vt. 解谜, 给...出谜, 筛, 寻根究底地检验, 充满于；vi. 出谜
example: The children tried to solve the riddle about the sun.
example_translation: 孩子们试图解开关于太阳的谜语。

source_meaning: vt. 使成熟；vi. 成熟
example: The tomatoes will ripen in a few days in the sun.
example_translation: 西红柿在阳光下几天就会成熟。

source_meaning: n. 锈, 生锈, 衰退；vi. 生锈, 衰退；vt. 使生锈, 腐蚀
example: The old bicycle left outside in the rain began to rust quickly.
example_translation: 那辆放在外面淋雨的旧自行车很快就开始生锈了。

source_meaning: n. 好骂街的人, 责骂；v. 责骂
example: The teacher will scold the students if they do not finish their homework on time.
example_translation: 如果学生不按时完成作业，老师会责骂他们。

source_meaning: n. 轻蔑, 藐视, 嘲笑, 被嘲弄的人；vt. 轻蔑, 不屑做
example: She looked at the dishonest salesman with utter scorn and refused to buy anything from him.
example_translation: 她以极其轻蔑的目光看着那个不诚实的推销员，拒绝从他那里购买任何东西。

source_meaning: n. 洗头, 洗发剂；vt. 洗头, 洗发
example: She bought a new shampoo for her dry hair.
example_translation: 她为干性头发买了一款新洗发水。

source_meaning: a. 熟练的, 巧妙的
example: The skillful carpenter made a beautiful wooden chair.
example_translation: 那位熟练的木匠做了一把漂亮的木椅。

source_meaning: n. 裂缝, 投币口, 狭长裂口；vt. 切开, 扯裂, 使有狭缝；vi. 纵切, 纵裂
example: He made a small slit in the envelope to open it.
example_translation: 他在信封上划了一个小口子来打开它。

source_meaning: n. 暴风雪
example: The snowstorm forced the airport to cancel all flights.
example_translation: 暴风雪迫使机场取消了所有航班。

source_meaning: n. 麻雀
example: A sparrow perched on the branch outside my window.
example_translation: 一只麻雀停在我窗外的树枝上。

source_meaning: n. 汽船, 蒸汽机
example: The steamer sailed across the Atlantic in five days.
example_translation: 这艘汽船五天横渡了大西洋。

source_meaning: a. 多石的, 无情的
example: The stony path was difficult to walk on.
example_translation: 这条多石的小路很难走。

source_meaning: vt. 减去, 扣掉, 减少；vi. 做减法
example: Please subtract five from ten to get the answer.
example_translation: 请从十中减去五得到答案。

source_meaning: a. 驯服的, 柔顺的, 被开垦的, 顺从的, 乏味的, 平淡的；vt. 驯养, 驯服, 制服, 失去锋芒；vi. 变得驯服
example: The zoo keeper tried to tame the wild lion.
example_translation: 动物园管理员试图驯服那头野生狮子。

source_meaning: n. 口渴, 渴望；vi. 口渴, 渴望
example: After the long run, he felt a great thirst for water.
example_translation: 长跑之后，他感到非常口渴想喝水。

source_meaning: n. 群, 人群, 群集, 众多；a. 拥挤的；vi. 群集, 蜂拥；vt. 在...群集, 使拥塞
example: A throng of fans gathered outside the stadium.
example_translation: 一大群粉丝聚集在体育场外。

source_meaning: a. 胆小的, 羞怯的
example: The timid girl was afraid to speak in public.
example_translation: 那个胆小的女孩害怕在公共场合说话。

source_meaning: n. 龟, 行动迟缓的人
example: The tortoise slowly crossed the road in the morning.
example_translation: 乌龟在早晨缓慢地穿过马路。

source_meaning: n. 变压器, 促使变化的人
example: The electrician replaced the faulty transformer in the substation.
example_translation: 电工更换了变电站里出故障的变压器。

source_meaning: n. 晶体管
example: The engineer replaced the faulty transistor in the radio to restore its function.
example_translation: 工程师更换了收音机里出故障的晶体管，使其恢复正常功能。

word_family.meaning: 使晶体管化；给…装晶体管

source_meaning: n. 叛逆, 不忠, 叛国罪
example: He was accused of treason for betraying his country.
example_translation: 他因背叛国家而被指控叛国罪。

source_meaning: n. 芜菁, 芜菁甘蓝
example: She added a chopped turnip to the stew for extra flavor and texture.
example_translation: 她往炖菜里加了一块切碎的芜菁，以增添风味和口感。

source_meaning: n. 闪烁, 闪耀, 瞬息；vi. 闪烁；vt. 使闪耀
example: The stars twinkle in the clear night sky.
example_translation: 星星在晴朗的夜空中闪烁。

source_meaning: n. 台风
example: The typhoon destroyed many houses along the coast.
example_translation: 台风摧毁了沿海的许多房屋。

source_meaning: n. 打字员
example: The typist quickly transcribed the meeting notes.

example_translation: 这座建筑在成为博物馆之前曾是一家医院。

source_meaning: n. 梦魇, 恶梦, 可怕的事物(或情景、人物)
example: She woke up in a cold sweat after a terrifying nightmare about falling.
example_translation: 她做了一个关于坠落的可怕噩梦后，冷汗淋漓地醒来。

source_meaning: n. 等级制度, 僧侣统治, 等级体系
example: The company has a strict hierarchy where each employee reports to a manager.
example_translation: 公司有严格的等级制度，每个员工都向经理汇报。

source_meaning: n. 罗马教皇, 主教
example: The pope addressed the crowd in St. Peter's Square during the Easter celebration.
example_translation: 教皇在复活节庆祝活动期间在圣彼得广场向人群发表讲话。

source_meaning: n. 地下室, 墙脚
example: They stored old furniture in the basement during the renovation.
example_translation: 翻新期间他们把旧家具存放在地下室。

source_meaning: n. 生产力
example: The new software significantly improved the team's productivity at work.
example_translation: 新软件显著提高了团队的工作效率。

source_meaning: n. 教条, 学说
example: The political doctrine of the party emphasizes equality and freedom.
example_translation: 该政党的政治学说强调平等与自由。

source_meaning: n. 调查表, 问卷
example: Please fill out the questionnaire about your shopping habits.
example_translation: 请填写关于你购物习惯的调查问卷。

source_meaning: n. 预言, 预报
example: The weather prediction for tomorrow calls for heavy rain.
example_translation: 明天的天气预报说有大雨。

source_meaning: n. 社会学
example: She is studying sociology at the university to understand social behavior.
example_translation: 她在大学学习社会学以理解社会行为。

source_meaning: n. 基础结构, 基础设施
example: The government invested heavily in the country's infrastructure to boost the economy.
example_translation: 政府大力投资国家基础设施以促进经济。

source_meaning: n. 随意, 随机；a. 任意的, 随便的, 胡乱的, 随机的；adv. 胡乱地
example: The teacher chose a random student to answer the question.
example_translation: 老师随机选了一个学生回答问题。

source_meaning: adv. 对, 正确, 恰当, 符合一般性准则, 符合行为准则, 端正, 符合
example: Please spell your name correctly on the form.
example_translation: 请在表格上正确拼写你的名字。

source_meaning: n. 罪行, 内疚
example: He felt a deep sense of guilt after lying to his friend.
example_translation: 对朋友撒谎后，他深感内疚。

source_meaning: n. 橡树, 橡木；a. 橡木制的
example: The old oak tree in the park provides shade for many visitors.
example_translation: 公园里的老橡树为许多游客提供阴凉。

source_meaning: adv. 同时发生, 一齐, 同时, 同时存在
example: The two events happened simultaneously, causing confusion among the audience.
example_translation: 两个事件同时发生，引起观众困惑。

source_meaning: n. 触发器, 扳机；vt. 触发, 发射, 引起；vi. 松开扳柄
example: Pulling the trigger too quickly can cause the gun to misfire.
example_translation: 扣动扳机太快会导致枪走火。

source_meaning: n. 采用, 采纳, 收养
example: The adoption of new technology has improved efficiency in the factory.
example_translation: 新技术的采用提高了工厂的效率。

source_meaning: n. 囚犯, 罪犯；vt. 宣告有罪, 使知罪
example: The jury took only two hours to convict the defendant of fraud.
example_translation: 陪审团仅用了两个小时就判定被告犯有欺诈罪。

source_meaning: n. 目录, 工商名录, 指南
example: You can find the company's contact information in the business directory.
example_translation: 你可以在工商名录中找到该公司的联系信息。

source_meaning: n. 网, 蛛丝, 蹼, 织物, 圈套, 卷筒纸；vi. 结网, 形成网；vt. 织蜘蛛网于, 使落入圈套
example: The spider spun a web between the branches to catch insects.
example_translation: 蜘蛛在树枝间结网捕捉昆虫。

source_meaning: n. 辩护, 证明正当, 释罪
example: There is no justification for his rude behavior towards the staff.
example_translation: 他对员工粗鲁的行为毫无正当理由。

source_meaning: n. 院长, 主持牧师
example: The dean of the college welcomed the new students at the orientation.
example_translation: 学院院长在迎新会上欢迎新生。

source_meaning: a. 详述的, 清楚的, 直言的
example: The teacher gave explicit instructions on how to complete the assignment.
example_translation: 老师就如何完成作业给出了明确的指示。

source_meaning: a. 极深的, 深厚的, 深刻的, 渊博的
example: The book offers a profound analysis of human nature and society.
example_translation: 这本书对人类本性和社会进行了深刻的分析。

source_meaning: vt. 废止, 革除, 消灭
example: The government decided to abolish the outdated tax law.
example_translation: 政府决定废除过时的税法。

source_meaning: n. 感觉, 轰动
example: The new movie created a sensation among young audiences.
example_translation: 这部新电影在年轻观众中引起了轰动。

source_meaning: n. 特征, 特性, 一笔, 少许
example: Patience is a valuable trait for a teacher.
example_translation: 耐心是教师宝贵的品质。

source_meaning: vt. 宣称, 主张, 提出, 断言
example: The prosecutor will allege that the defendant committed fraud during the trial.
example_translation: 检察官将在庭审中指控被告犯有欺诈罪。

source_meaning: n. 额外补贴, 奖金, 奖赏, 保险费
example: Customers pay a premium for organic food products.
example_translation: 顾客为有机食品支付额外费用。

source_meaning: n. 有效性, 可利用性, 可利用的人
example: The availability of clean water is a major concern in many regions.
example_translation: 清洁水的可用性是许多地区的主要关切。

source_meaning: n. 附录, 附加物, 阑尾
example: The appendix of the book contains a list of references.
example_translation: 书的附录包含参考文献列表。

source_meaning: n. 修正, 修饰, 修改
example: The committee proposed a modification to the original plan.
example_translation: 委员会提议对原计划进行修改。

source_meaning: n. 论坛, 公开讨论的广场, 法庭, 讨论会
example: The university hosted a forum on climate change.
example_translation: 大学举办了一个关于气候变化的论坛。

source_meaning: a. 意味深长的
example: She gave a meaningful look at her friend across the room.
example_translation: 她意味深长地看了一眼房间对面的朋友。

source_meaning: n. 恐慌, 惊慌；a. 惊慌的, 没有理由的, 恐慌的；vt. 使惊慌, 使狂热；vi. 惊慌
example: The sudden fire caused panic among the crowd.
example_translation: 突然的火灾在人群中引起了恐慌。

source_meaning: n. 配偶
example: Each employee may bring their spouse to the company party.
example_translation: 每位员工可以带配偶参加公司聚会。

source_meaning: n. 奖金, 红利
example: The company gives a bonus to employees who meet their targets.
example_translation: 公司给达到目标的员工发放奖金。

source_meaning: n. 钠
example: High sodium intake can lead to high blood pressure.
example_translation: 高钠摄入可能导致高血压。

source_meaning: n. 暴动, 喧闹, 放纵；vi. 发动, 暴动, 纵情, 放荡；vt. 浪费, 挥霍
example: The protest turned into a riot when police arrived.
example_translation: 警察到达时，抗议演变成了暴乱。

source_meaning: n. 榨出物, 精汁, 摘录, 选段；vt. (费力地)取出, 采掘, 榨取, 摘录, 吸取
example: The dentist had to extract the damaged tooth.
example_translation: 牙医不得不拔掉那颗损坏的牙齿。

source_meaning: vt. 献出, 贡献
example: She decided to dedicate her entire career to improving public health in rural areas.
example_translation: 她决定将自己整个职业生涯奉献给改善农村地区的公共卫生事业。

source_meaning: vt. 构思, 认为；vi. 怀孕
example: It is hard to conceive of a world without the internet.
example_translation: 很难想象一个没有互联网的世界。

source_meaning: n. 诺言, 约会, 婚约, 交战
example: Their engagement was announced in the local newspaper.
example_translation: 他们的订婚在当地报纸上公布了。

source_meaning: a. 奇异的, 神奇的, 奇迹般的, 惊人的, 不可思议的, 绝妙的, 妙极的
example: The view from the mountain top was absolutely marvellous.
example_translation: 山顶的景色简直妙极了。

source_meaning: prep. 在其间, 在其中
example: Amid the chaos of the city, she found a quiet park to relax.
example_translation: 在城市的喧嚣中，她找到了一座安静的公园放松。

source_meaning: n. 商人, 商船
example: The trader bought a large shipment of coffee beans from Brazil to sell in Europe.
example_translation: 这位商人从巴西购买了一大批咖啡豆，准备在欧洲出售。

source_meaning: v. 诊断
example: The doctor used a series of tests to diagnose the patient's rare condition.
example_translation: 医生通过一系列检查来诊断病人的罕见病症。

source_meaning: vt. 面对, 正视, 想象
example: We envisage a future where renewable energy powers every home.
example_translation: 我们设想一个可再生能源为每个家庭供电的未来。

source_meaning: a. 优雅的, 端庄的, 高雅的
example: She wore an elegant black dress to the formal dinner party.
example_translation: 她穿着一件优雅的黑色连衣裙参加正式晚宴。

source_meaning: n. 紧抱, 拥抱；vt. 紧抱, 坚持, 使沾沾自喜
example: The mother gave her child a warm hug after he returned from school.
example_translation: 孩子放学回来后，母亲给了他一个温暖的拥抱。

source_meaning: vt. 承认, 退让；vi. 让步
example: After the debate, he had to concede that his opponent's argument was stronger.
example_translation: 辩论结束后，他不得不承认对手的论点更有力。

source_meaning: n. 实体, 实存物, 存在
example: The company is a separate legal entity from its owners.
example_translation: 该公司是一个独立于其所有者的法律实体。

source_meaning: vt. 更新, 使现代化；n. 更新
example: Please update the software to the latest version to fix the security issues.
example_translation: 请将软件更新到最新版本以修复安全问题。

source_meaning: n. 探险, 踏勘, 探测
example: The exploration of the deep ocean has revealed many new species.
example_translation: 深海探索揭示了许多新物种。

source_meaning: n. 论题, 论文
example: She spent two years writing her thesis on climate change and its effects on agriculture.
example_translation: 她花了两年时间撰写关于气候变化及其对农业影响的论文。

source_meaning: n. 共和国；联邦；国民整体
example: The British Commonwealth of Nations was established to promote cooperation among its member states.
example_translation: 英联邦的建立旨在促进其成员国之间的合作。

source_meaning: n. 子公司, 附件, 辅助者；a. 辅助的, 次要的, 津贴的
example: The company's subsidiary in Brazil handles all South American operations.
example_translation: 该公司在巴西的子公司负责所有南美业务。

source_meaning: a. 领受的, 容易接受的, 感受性强的；n. 领受者, 容纳者, 容器
example: The scholarship recipient expressed her gratitude to the donors.
example_translation: 奖学金获得者向捐赠者表达了感激之情。

source_meaning: n. 偏见, 斜纹；a. 偏斜的；adv. 偏斜；vt. 使有偏见
example: The news report showed a clear bias against the minority group.
example_translation: 这篇新闻报道明显对少数群体有偏见。

source_meaning: vt. 编辑, 编校, 修订, 剪辑
example: The editor will edit the article before it is published in the magazine.
example_translation: 编辑将在文章发表前对其进行编辑。

source_meaning: n. 意外事故, 伤亡, 受害者
example: The hospital reported a high number of casualties after the earthquake.
example_translation: 医院报告称地震后伤亡人数众多。

source_meaning: vt. 注视, 沉思, 盘算；vi. 冥思苦想
example: She sat by the window to contemplate the meaning of life.
example_translation: 她坐在窗边沉思生命的意义。

source_meaning: n. 剩余物, 其他人, 残余, 余数；v. 削价出售(图书)；a. 剩余的, 出售削价剩书的
example: After paying the bills, she put the remainder of her salary into savings.
example_translation: 付完账单后，她把工资的剩余部分存了起来。

source_meaning: vi. 插入, 调停, 干涉
example: The teacher had to intervene when the two students started arguing loudly in class.
example_translation: 当两个学生在课堂上大声争吵时，老师不得不进行干预。

source_meaning: v. (使)减少, (使)变小
example: The heavy rain did not diminish the enthusiasm of the crowd waiting for the concert.
example_translation: 大雨并没有减弱等待音乐会的人群的热情。

source_meaning: n. 意图, 含义, 故意；a. 专心的, 决心的, 热心的
example: She studied with the clear intent of passing the exam on her first attempt.
example_translation: 她学习时明确意图是一次通过考试。

source_meaning: n. 详细目录, 存货清单；vt. 列入详细目录, 清点存货
example: The store manager checked the inventory to see which items needed to be reordered.
example_translation: 商店经理检查了库存，看看哪些商品需要补货。

source_meaning: a. 例外的, 异常的, 特别的
example: Her exceptional performance in the competition earned her a scholarship to the university.
example_translation: 她在比赛中的出色表现为她赢得了大学奖学金。

source_meaning: n. 巨大, 重大, 重要, 大小, 数量, 星等(指星的亮度)
example: The magnitude of the earthquake was measured at 7.2 on the Richter scale.
example_translation: 这次地震的震级为里氏7.2级。

source_meaning: n. 人质, 抵押品
example: The terrorists took several tourists hostage and demanded a large ransom.
example_translation: 恐怖分子劫持了几名游客作为人质，并索要巨额赎金。

source_meaning: n. 名声, 受大众欢迎, 流行
example: The popularity of online learning has increased dramatically in recent years.
example_translation: 近年来，在线学习的普及度急剧上升。

source_meaning: n. 监督, 管理
example: The children played in the park under the supervision of their teacher.
example_translation: 孩子们在老师的监督下在公园里玩耍。

source_meaning: n. 外国人, 外侨；a. 外国的, 相异的
example: The movie tells the story of an alien who lands on Earth and befriends a young boy.
example_translation: 这部电影讲述了一个外星人降落地球并与一个小男孩成为朋友的故事。

source_meaning: n. 摄影, 摄影术
example: She has a passion for photography and often spends weekends taking pictures of nature.
example_translation: 她对摄影充满热情，经常在周末拍摄自然风光。

source_meaning: n. 实行, 完成, 执行, 死刑
example: The execution of the new policy will take place at the beginning of next month.
example_translation: 新政策的执行将于下月初开始。

source_meaning: n. 类似, 类似处
example: There is a striking similarity between the two paintings, suggesting they were created by the same artist.
example_translation: 这两幅画之间有惊人的相似之处，表明它们出自同一位艺术家之手。

source_meaning: n. 聚集, 集中, 采集
example: The family gathering at Thanksgiving brought together relatives from all over the country.
example_translation: 感恩节的家庭聚会汇集了来自全国各地的亲戚。

source_meaning: vt. 招致, 蒙受, 遭遇
example: If you break the rules, you may incur serious penalties from the school.
example_translation: 如果你违反规定，可能会招致学校的严厉处罚。

source_meaning: a. 海岸的, 沿海的, 沿岸的
example: The coastal city attracts many tourists every summer because of its beautiful beaches.
example_translation: 这座沿海城市每年夏天都吸引许多游客，因为其美丽的海滩。

source_meaning: n. 成分, 选民, 构成物；a. 构成的, 组织的, 选举的
example: The senator promised to address the concerns of every constituent in her district.
example_translation: 这位参议员承诺解决她所在选区每一位选民关心的问题。

source_meaning: a. 神的, 神圣的, 非凡的；n. 神学家
example: The ancient temple was built to honor the divine power of the sun god.
example_translation: 这座古庙是为了纪念太阳神的神圣力量而建造的。

source_meaning: a. 暂时的, 临时的, 间歇的；n. 过渡时期
example: The company appointed an interim manager to handle operations while the CEO was on leave.
example_translation: 公司任命了一位临时经理在首席执行官休假期间处理运营事务。

source_meaning: n. 灵感, 鼓舞人心的人或物, 妙计, 吸气
example: The artist found inspiration for her new painting while walking through the old town.
example_translation: 这位艺术家在穿过老城区时为新画作找到了灵感。

source_meaning: n. 参变数, 参变量, 参数, 参量
example: The experiment's success depends on adjusting the key parameter of temperature carefully.
example_translation: 实验的成功取决于仔细调整温度这一关键参数。

source_meaning: n. 探索, 寻求, 调查；v. 寻找, 找, 追寻猎物
example: The knight embarked on a quest to find the lost treasure.
example_translation: 骑士踏上了寻找失落宝藏的征程。

source_meaning: n. 掴, 掌击, 侮辱, 拍击声；v. 拍击, 惩罚；adv. 正面地, 直接地, 突然地
example: She gave him a slap on the face for his rude comment.
example_translation: 她因为他的粗鲁言论打了他一记耳光。

source_meaning: a. 有毒的, 中毒的
example: The factory released toxic chemicals into the river, harming the fish.
example_translation: 工厂向河里排放有毒化学物质，危害了鱼类。

source_meaning: n. 伤心, 忧愁, 悲痛, 不幸, 灾难
example: She was overcome with grief after losing her beloved dog.
example_translation: 失去心爱的狗后，她悲痛欲绝。

source_meaning: v. 捐赠
example: Many people donate money to charity during the holiday season.
example_translation: 许多人在节日期间向慈善机构捐款。

source_meaning: n. 崩溃, 故障
example: The car had a breakdown on the highway, causing a traffic jam.
example_translation: 汽车在高速公路上抛锚，造成了交通堵塞。

source_meaning: n. 尊严, 高贵
example: He faced the criticism with dignity and did not lose his temper.
example_translation: 他尊严地面对批评，没有发脾气。

source_meaning: a. 即将来临的；n. 来临
example: The forthcoming election will determine the country's future direction.
example_translation: 即将到来的选举将决定国家的未来方向。

source_meaning: n. 困境, (进退两难的)窘境
example: She faced a dilemma between pursuing her career and raising a family.
example_translation: 她在追求事业和养育家庭之间面临两难困境。

source_meaning: n. 处女；a. 处女的, 贞洁的, 纯洁的, 初始的, 纯的
example: The explorers discovered a virgin forest untouched by human activity.
example_translation: 探险家发现了一片未受人类活动影响的原始森林。

source_meaning: vi. 一致, 符合
example: My vacation plans coincide with the company's annual meeting.
example_translation: 我的假期计划与公司的年会时间重合。

source_meaning: n. 虾, 小虾, 矮子；vi. 捕小虾
example: We ordered grilled shrimp with garlic butter for dinner.
example_translation: 我们晚餐点了蒜蓉黄油烤虾。

source_meaning: n. 装束, 服装
example: She wore a traditional costume to the cultural festival and received many compliments.
example_translation: 她穿着传统服装参加文化节，收获了许多赞美。

word_family.meaning: 服装供应商；戏装保管员

source_meaning: n. 卡通画, 漫画；v. 画漫画
example: The children laughed at the funny cartoon about a clever mouse and a clumsy cat.
example_translation: 孩子们看了那部关于聪明老鼠和笨猫的有趣卡通片，都笑了起来。

source_meaning: n. 错误, 虫, 病菌, 缺陷, 窃听器, 癖好, 防盗报警器, 双座小汽车, 要人；vt. 装防盗报警器, 装窃听器, 激怒；vi. 捉虫, 暴突
example: The software has a bug that causes it to crash frequently.
example_translation: 这个软件有一个导致频繁崩溃的漏洞。

source_meaning: a. 易接近的, 可进入的, 可使用的, 易受影响的, 可理解的
example: The building is accessible to people with disabilities.

source_meaning: n. 吸引力, 魔力, 符咒；vt. 迷住, 使陶醉, 行魔法；vi. 用符咒, 有魅力

example_translation: 护士在他手臂上找到了一条合适的静脉来抽血。

source_meaning: n. 砖瓦, 瓷砖, 瓦片；vt. 铺以瓦, 铺以瓷砖

example_translation: 她是一位精明的女商人，总是做出明智的投资。

source_meaning: a. 不稳的, 脾气暴燥的, 易怒的；n. 曲柄, 奇想；vt. 装曲柄；vi. 转动曲柄
example: He turned the crank to start the old engine.
example_translation: 他转动曲柄启动旧发动机。

source_meaning: vt. 偷运, 走私, 私运；vi. 走私
example: They attempted to smuggle drugs across the border in a truck.
example_translation: 他们试图用卡车把毒品走私过境。

source_meaning: n. 薄荷, 造币厂, 巨额；vt. 铸造, 铸币, 制造
example: The royal mint produces coins that are used across the entire country.
example_translation: 皇家铸币厂生产全国使用的硬币。

source_meaning: n. 沉淀物, 凝结物, 结果；vt. 猛抛, 使陷入, 促成, 使沉淀；vi. 猛地落下；a. 突然的, 猛地落下的, 轻率的
example: The sudden drop in temperature will precipitate the formation of ice on the road.
example_translation: 温度的骤降会导致路面结冰。

source_meaning: n. 苔藓, 泥沼；vt. 使长满苔藓
example: The old stone wall was covered with thick green moss after years of rain.
example_translation: 多年雨水之后，那堵旧石墙长满了厚厚的绿色苔藓。

source_meaning: a. 意见一致的, 无异议的
example: The committee reached a unanimous decision to approve the new budget proposal.
example_translation: 委员会一致决定批准新的预算提案。

source_meaning: n. 旅行者, 朝圣者, 香客；vi. 朝圣
example: The pilgrim traveled to the holy city to pray at the ancient temple.
example_translation: 这位朝圣者前往圣城，在古老的寺庙里祈祷。

source_meaning: n. 蜗牛, 行动迟缓的人, 脑筋迟钝的人, 蜗形凸轮；vt. (蜗牛般)缓慢地打发(时间)；vi. 缓慢移动
example: The snail slowly crawled across the wet pavement after the rain stopped.
example_translation: 雨停后，蜗牛慢慢地爬过湿漉漉的人行道。

collocations.meaning: 传统邮件（相对于电子邮件）

source_meaning: n. (多面体的)面, 方面, 琢面
example: The diamond's most brilliant facet caught the light and dazzled everyone in the room.
example_translation: 钻石最闪亮的一个切面捕捉到光线，让房间里的每个人都为之目眩。

source_meaning: vt. 打, 使逆行, 胜过, 推敲, 鞭打；vi. 打谷, 痛打, 剧烈扭动, 逆行；n. 打谷, (划水)鞭状动作
example: The farmer used a machine to thrash the wheat and separate the grain.
example_translation: 农民用机器打麦子，把谷粒分离出来。

source_meaning: vt. 击倒；n. 一季所伐的木材, 折缝；a. 凶猛的, 可怕的；fall的过去式
example: The lumberjack used a sharp axe to fell the tall pine tree.
example_translation: 伐木工人用锋利的斧头砍倒了那棵高大的松树。

source_meaning: a. 不育的, 贫瘠的；n. 荒地
example: The barren desert offered no shelter or water for the lost travelers.
example_translation: 这片贫瘠的沙漠无法为迷路的旅行者提供庇护或水源。

source_meaning: n. 铰链, 关键, 枢纽；vt. 装铰链；vi. 靠铰链移动, 依...而转移
example: The door swung open smoothly because the hinge was well oiled.
example_translation: 门平稳地打开了，因为铰链上了油。

source_meaning: n. 百叶窗, 关闭物, 照相机快门, 关闭者；vt. 为...装百叶窗, 以百叶窗遮闭
example: She pressed the shutter button to capture the beautiful sunset.
example_translation: 她按下快门按钮捕捉美丽的日落。

source_meaning: n. 海峡, 困境；a. 困难的, 窘迫的, 狭窄的
example: The ship navigated carefully through the narrow strait between the two islands.
example_translation: 船小心地穿过两岛之间的狭窄海峡。

source_meaning: a. 互惠的, 相互的, 相等的, 倒数的, 彼此相反的；n. 倒数, 互相起作用的事物
example: The two countries signed a reciprocal trade agreement to reduce tariffs.
example_translation: 两国签署了互惠贸易协定以降低关税。

source_meaning: n. 换置, 移位, 移动, 取代
example: The displacement of the population caused by the flood was a major concern.
example_translation: 洪水造成的人口迁移是一个主要问题。

source_meaning: vt. 使同化, 吸收, 使相拟, 把...比作；vi. 被吸收, 被同化
example: Immigrants often assimilate into the local culture while preserving their own traditions.
example_translation: 移民常常融入当地文化，同时保留自己的传统。

source_meaning: vt. 使膨胀, 使得意, 使通货膨胀, 使充气；vi. 充气, 膨胀
example: You need to inflate the tires before driving on the highway.
example_translation: 上高速公路前你需要给轮胎充气。

source_meaning: n. 长命, 长寿, 寿命
example: Regular exercise and a balanced diet are key factors for longevity.
example_translation: 规律运动和均衡饮食是长寿的关键因素。

source_meaning: n. 沉思, 冥想；v. 沉思, 冥想, 若有所思地凝望或说
example: She sat by the window and began to muse about her future career choices.
example_translation: 她坐在窗边，开始沉思自己未来的职业选择。

source_meaning: n. 柳树, 柳木制品；a. 柳树的, 柳木制的
example: The willow tree by the river swayed gently in the breeze.
example_translation: 河边的柳树在微风中轻轻摇曳。

source_meaning: n. 炉床, 灶台, 炉边
example: The family gathered around the hearth to keep warm during the cold winter night.
example_translation: 寒冷的冬夜，一家人围坐在炉边取暖。

source_meaning: a. 轻率的, 匆忙的, 鲁莽的；n. 皮疹
example: He developed a red rash on his arm after touching the poisonous plant.
example_translation: 他接触有毒植物后，手臂上起了红色皮疹。

source_meaning: adv. 在其中, 关于..., 由此
example: The contract specifies the terms and the conditions thereof.
example_translation: 合同规定了条款及其条件。

source_meaning: a. 指示的, 象征的, 表示...的
example: Her smile was indicative of her approval of the plan.
example_translation: 她的微笑表明她赞同这个计划。

source_meaning: n. 混合者, 混合器, 搅拌机, 搅拌器, 混频器, (非正式)交际家, 与人相处的人
example: The chef used an electric mixer to blend the ingredients.
example_translation: 厨师用电动搅拌机混合原料。

source_meaning: n. 弹药筒, 弹药, 一卷软片, 墨粉鼓
example: He inserted a new ink cartridge into the printer.
example_translation: 他把新墨盒插入打印机。

source_meaning: n. 葡萄干
example: She added a handful of raisins to the oatmeal for extra sweetness.
example_translation: 她往燕麦粥里加了一把葡萄干，增添甜味。

source_meaning: n. 拖, 拖绳, 拖轮；vt. 拖, 拉, 牵引
example: The truck came to tow the broken car away.
example_translation: 卡车来把坏车拖走。

source_meaning: n. 维纳斯(爱与美的女神), 金星
example: Venus is the brightest planet visible from Earth.
example_translation: 金星是从地球可见的最亮的行星。

source_meaning: n. 流出, 涨潮, 变迁；vi. 熔化, 流出；vt. 使熔融
example: The company is in a state of flux during the merger.
example_translation: 合并期间公司处于不断变化之中。

source_meaning: adv. 虽然, 尽管；prep. 尽管；conj. 虽然
example: Notwithstanding the rain, the match continued.
example_translation: 尽管下雨，比赛仍继续进行。

source_meaning: n. 宴会
example: The university held a banquet to honor the alumni.
example_translation: 大学举办宴会以表彰校友。

source_meaning: n. 肺结核

example_translation: 肺结核是一种影响肺部的严重传染病。

source_meaning: n. 凤梨, 菠萝, 失业救济金

example_translation: 她把新鲜菠萝切成片做水果沙拉。

source_meaning: n. 赌博, 冒险；v. 赌博, 孤注一掷
example: He decided to gamble his savings on the risky investment.
example_translation: 他决定把积蓄赌在风险投资上。

source_meaning: vt. 安慰, 藉慰；n. 控制台
example: She tried to console her friend after the loss.
example_translation: 她试图在朋友失去后安慰她。

source_meaning: a. 圆胖的, 丰满的, 直接下落的, 直率的；vt. 突然放下, 支持, 使丰满, 使鼓起；vi. 扑通落下, 投票赞成, 变丰满, 鼓起；adv. 沉重地, 突然地, 直截了当地
example: The baby has plump cheeks that everyone wants to pinch.
example_translation: 婴儿有胖乎乎的脸颊，人人都想捏。

source_meaning: n. 织布者, 织工

example_translation: 织工花了数小时制作精美的挂毯。

source_meaning: a. 同种的, 同质的, 齐性的
example: The population of the small town is remarkably homogeneous.
example_translation: 这个小镇的人口非常同质。

source_meaning: n. 杜鹃鸟, 布谷鸟
example: The cuckoo is known for laying its eggs in other birds' nests.
example_translation: 布谷鸟以在其他鸟巢中产卵而闻名。

source_meaning: a. 拳曲的, 卷毛的, 弯曲的
example: The little girl has curly hair that bounces when she runs.
example_translation: 小女孩有一头卷发，跑起来时一弹一弹的。

source_meaning: n. 副本, 复本, 复制品；a. 复制的, 二重的；vt. 复制, 使加倍

example_translation: 请为档案制作一份报告的副本。

source_meaning: n. 没有, 零, 无

example_translation: 最终比分是三比零，主队庆祝了他们的胜利。

source_meaning: a. 歇斯底里的, 异常兴奋的
example: The crowd became hysterical when the band finally walked onto the stage.
example_translation: 当乐队终于走上舞台时，人群变得异常兴奋。

source_meaning: n. 走失的家畜, 浪子；a. 迷途的, 偶然的；vi. 迷路, 彷徨, 流浪
example: The stray dog wandered into our yard and looked hungry, so we gave it some food.
example_translation: 那只走失的狗溜进我们院子，看起来很饿，于是我们给了它一些食物。

source_meaning: n. 瓦(特)

example_translation: 一个典型的灯泡大约消耗60瓦的电。

source_meaning: n. (教堂)中殿, 中央广场, 轮毂

example_translation: 婚礼宾客们安静地坐在古老教堂的中殿。

source_meaning: n. 溢值, 超值, 泛滥；v. (使)泛滥, (使)溢出, (使)充溢

example_translation: 大雨导致河水漫过堤岸，淹没了附近的田地。

source_meaning: n. 不透明物；a. 不透明的, 不传热的, 不传导的, 阴暗的
example: The glass in the bathroom window is opaque to protect privacy.
example_translation: 浴室窗户的玻璃是不透明的，以保护隐私。

source_meaning: n. 光束, 微光, 反光；vi. 闪烁, 隐约地闪现；vt. 使发微光, 使闪烁
example: A faint gleam of light appeared through the curtains at dawn.
example_translation: 黎明时分，一丝微光透过窗帘显现。

source_meaning: n. 流氓, 歹徒
example: The gangster was arrested by the police after a long chase through the city.
example_translation: 经过在城市中的长时间追捕，警察逮捕了那名歹徒。

source_meaning: n. 大猩猩, 残暴的男人, 歹徒
example: The gorilla in the zoo is very gentle and loves to eat bananas.
example_translation: 动物园里的大猩猩非常温顺，喜欢吃香蕉。

source_meaning: n. 同化, 同化作用, 吸收
example: The assimilation of immigrants into the local culture takes time and effort.
example_translation: 移民融入当地文化的同化过程需要时间和努力。

source_meaning: n. 精炼厂

example_translation: 炼油厂将原油加工成汽油和其他产品。

example_translation: 中子不带电荷，因此不受电场影响。

source_meaning: n. 神经原, 轴索, 神经细胞
example: Each neuron in the brain communicates with thousands of other neurons.
example_translation: 大脑中的每个神经元都与成千上万的其他神经元交流。

source_meaning: n. 动摇, 踌躇, 挥动者；vi. 摇摆, 颤抖, 摆动, 摇曳, 犹豫

example_translation: 火焰在强风中开始摇曳，在墙上投下舞动的影子。

source_meaning: n. 魔术家, 幻术家, 术士
example: The magician pulled a rabbit out of his hat and amazed the children.
example_translation: 魔术师从帽子里变出一只兔子，让孩子们惊叹不已。

source_meaning: n. 预言, 预言能力
example: The ancient prophecy predicted the fall of the great empire.
example_translation: 古老的预言预测了大帝国的衰落。

source_meaning: vt. 授予, 使用, 贮藏, 留宿
example: The university will bestow an honorary degree upon the famous scientist during the ceremony.
example_translation: 大学将在典礼上授予这位著名科学家荣誉学位。

source_meaning: n. 绷带

example_translation: 护士小心地把干净的绷带包扎在他手臂的伤口上。

source_meaning: n. 升高, 起重机, 推动；v. 升起, 升高, 举起
example: They used a crane to hoist the heavy equipment onto the roof.
example_translation: 他们用起重机把重型设备吊到屋顶上。

source_meaning: n. 缠结, 纠结的一团, 困惑, 纠纷, 混乱；vt. 使缠结, 缠住；vi. 缠结, 乱作一团

example_translation: 暴风雨过后，钓鱼线缠成了一团，很难分开。

collocations.meaning: 处于混乱状态；纠缠不清

source_meaning: n. 跛行；a. 柔软的, 无力的, 软弱的；vi. 跛行
example: After twisting his ankle, he walked with a noticeable limp for several days.
example_translation: 扭伤脚踝后，他好几天走路都明显一瘸一拐。

source_meaning: n. 胳肢, 痒；vt. 胳肢, 使发痒, 使快乐, 逗乐；vi. 觉得痒, 使人痒
example: The feather used to tickle the baby's nose made her laugh uncontrollably.
example_translation: 用来挠婴儿鼻子的羽毛让她 uncontrollably 大笑起来。

source_meaning: vt. 给予, 传授, 告知
example: The teacher aimed to impart not only knowledge but also a love of learning to her students.
example_translation: 这位老师旨在不仅传授知识，还培养学生对学习的热爱。

source_meaning: a. 紫外线的
example: Ultraviolet radiation from the sun can damage your skin if you stay outside too long.
example_translation: 如果你在户外待太久，太阳的紫外线辐射会伤害你的皮肤。

source_meaning: n. 废止, 撤消；vt. 废止, 撤消, 放弃
example: The government decided to repeal the outdated law that had been criticized for years.
example_translation: 政府决定废除那项多年来一直受到批评的过时法律。

source_meaning: a. 在前的, 以前的；adv. 在前面, 在船头；prep. 在...前
example: The captain stood at the fore of the ship, watching the horizon for any sign of land.
example_translation: 船长站在船头，注视着地平线寻找陆地的迹象。

source_meaning: adv. 过多, 极度, 过度, 过分
example: He was excessively worried about the exam, even though he had studied thoroughly.
example_translation: 尽管他已经充分复习了，他还是过度担心考试。

source_meaning: vt. 使认识, 介绍
example: The seminar was designed to acquaint new employees with the company's policies and culture.
example_translation: 这次研讨会旨在让新员工了解公司的政策和文化。

source_meaning: a. 显微镜的, 用显微镜可见的, 微观的, (非正式)极微小的, 细微的

example_translation: 微生物在有机物的分解中起着至关重要的作用。

source_meaning: a. 令人愉快的, 同意的
example: The weather was agreeable, so we decided to have a picnic in the park.
example_translation: 天气宜人，所以我们决定去公园野餐。

source_meaning: n. 损害, 伤害, 灾祸, 恶作剧, 淘气

example_translation: 孩子们淘气极了，藏起老师的粉笔咯咯笑。

source_meaning: a. 发光的, 明亮的
example: The luminous dial of the clock glowed softly in the dark bedroom.
example_translation: 时钟的发光表盘在黑暗的卧室里发出柔和的光。

source_meaning: a. 高的, 傲慢的, 崇高的, 高级的, 玄虚的
example: The lofty mountains were covered with snow even in the middle of summer.
example_translation: 即使在盛夏，高耸的山峰也覆盖着积雪。

source_meaning: n. 脊椎, 志气, 骨干, 支柱
example: Small businesses are the backbone of the local economy, providing jobs and services.
example_translation: 小企业是当地经济的支柱，提供就业和服务。

source_meaning: vi. 逝去, 过去；n. 逝去, 过去
example: Several months elapsed before we received any news from the expedition team.
example_translation: 几个月过去了，我们才收到探险队的消息。

source_meaning: v. 浏览, 吃草；n. 浏览, 吃草
example: She likes to browse through fashion magazines to keep up with the latest trends.
example_translation: 她喜欢翻阅时尚杂志以跟上最新潮流。

source_meaning: a. 有影的, 暗黑的, 朦胧的, 虚幻的
example: In the shadowy corner of the room, a figure seemed to be watching them.
example_translation: 在房间阴暗的角落里，似乎有个人影在看着他们。

source_meaning: v. 发明, 设计, 图谋
example: She managed to contrive a clever plan to escape the locked room.
example_translation: 她设法设计了一个巧妙的计划逃出锁着的房间。

source_meaning: a. 发光的, 明亮的, 辐射的, 容光焕发的
example: The bride looked radiant in her white dress, smiling at all the guests.
example_translation: 新娘穿着白色礼服，容光焕发，对所有客人微笑。

source_meaning: n. 细软, 精致, 精美的食品, 娇气, 微妙, 棘手, 娇弱, 灵敏, 灵巧
example: The chef prepared a local delicacy that impressed all the guests at the banquet.
example_translation: 厨师准备了一道当地美食，给宴会上的所有客人留下了深刻印象。

source_meaning: n. 保险丝, 导火线；v. 熔化, 融合
example: The electrician replaced the blown fuse to restore power to the entire house.
example_translation: 电工更换了烧断的保险丝，恢复了整个房子的供电。

source_meaning: n. 平头钉, 大头钉, 粗缝针脚, 行动方针, 食物；vt. 以大头针钉住, 附加
example: She used a tack to pin the notice on the bulletin board in the hallway.
example_translation: 她用一颗图钉把通知钉在走廊的公告板上。

source_meaning: n. 震动, 颤抖, 箭袋；vi. 颤抖, 振动；vt. 使颤动；a. 敏捷的

example_translation: 兔子察觉到附近的危险时，鼻子开始颤抖起来。

source_meaning: n. 漫步, 随笔；vi. 漫步, 漫谈, 漫游, 蔓延；vt. 闲逛于
example: We went for a ramble through the forest and enjoyed the fresh air.
example_translation: 我们去森林里漫步，享受新鲜空气。

source_meaning: n. 流氓, 无赖, 坏蛋, 淘气鬼
example: The little rascal hid my keys again, but I couldn't stay angry at him for long.
example_translation: 那个小淘气又把我的钥匙藏起来了，但我没法对他生气太久。

source_meaning: n. 指责, 谴责, 非难；vt. 斥责, 指责, 制止
example: The manager gave a sharp rebuke to the employee for missing the deadline.
example_translation: 经理因员工错过截止日期而严厉斥责了他。

source_meaning: n. 长方形, 矩形
example: The garden is shaped like a rectangle, with the longer sides facing the street.
example_translation: 花园呈长方形，较长的边朝向街道。

source_meaning: vt. 逐退, 抵制, 使厌恶, 抗御；vi. 使厌恶, 相互排斥
example: The strong smell of garlic can repel mosquitoes effectively during summer nights.
example_translation: 大蒜的强烈气味能在夏夜有效驱赶蚊子。

source_meaning: n. 爬行动物, 爬虫, 卑鄙的人；a. 爬行的, 爬虫类的, 卑鄙的
example: The reptile basked on the warm rock, its scales glistening in the morning sun.
example_translation: 那只爬行动物在温暖的岩石上晒太阳，鳞片在晨光中闪闪发光。

word_family.meaning: 爬行动物的；像爬行动物的

source_meaning: n. 必需品, 要素, 必要物品；a. 必要的, 需要的
example: A valid passport is a requisite for international travel to most countries.
example_translation: 有效护照是前往大多数国家国际旅行的必要条件。

source_meaning: n. 果断的人；a. 坚决的, 刚毅的, 毅然的
example: She remained resolute in her decision to study abroad despite the difficulties.
example_translation: 尽管困难重重，她仍坚决地决定出国留学。

source_meaning: n. 嘲笑, 愚弄, 笑柄；vt. 嘲笑, 嘲弄, 愚弄
example: His strange accent became the subject of ridicule among his classmates.
example_translation: 他奇怪的口音成了同学们嘲笑的对象。

source_meaning: n. 公鸡, 栖息的鸟
example: The rooster crowed loudly at dawn, waking up the whole farm.
example_translation: 公鸡在黎明时大声啼叫，吵醒了整个农场。

source_meaning: n. 红宝石, 深红色；a. 红宝石色的, 深红色的；vt. 使带红宝石色
example: She wore a necklace with a deep red ruby that sparkled in the light.
example_translation: 她戴着一条镶有深红色红宝石的项链，在光下闪闪发光。

source_meaning: n. 沙丁鱼
example: The fisherman caught a sardine and put it in the bucket.
example_translation: 渔夫捕到一条沙丁鱼，把它放进了桶里。

collocations.meaning: 拥挤不堪，像沙丁鱼一样挤在一起

source_meaning: n. 土星
example: Saturn is famous for its beautiful rings, which are made of ice and rock.
example_translation: 土星以其美丽的环而闻名，这些环由冰和岩石组成。

source_meaning: n. 烧焦, 枯萎；v. 烧焦, 拷焦, (使)枯萎, 讽刺
example: The iron was too hot and left a scorch mark on the white shirt.
example_translation: 熨斗太热，在白衬衫上留下了一个焦痕。

source_meaning: n. 巨蛇座, 蛇, 蛇形管, 狡猾的人
example: The ancient myth tells of a giant serpent guarding the treasure in the cave.
example_translation: 古代神话讲述了一条巨蛇守护洞穴中的宝藏。

source_meaning: n. 假, 赝品, 骗子, 哄骗；a. 假的, 伪造的；vt. 假装, 冒充；vi. 装假
example: The trial was a sham, with the verdict decided long before the hearing.
example_translation: 这场审判是场骗局，判决在听证会之前很久就已定下。

source_meaning: n. 捷径, 最短路线
example: He took a shortcut through the park to get to school faster.
example_translation: 他穿过公园抄近路，以便更快到学校。

source_meaning: n. 速记
example: The secretary took notes in shorthand during the meeting.
example_translation: 秘书在会议期间用速记做笔记。

source_meaning: n. 尖声；a. 尖锐的, 刺耳的；vt. 尖声说出；vi. 发出刺耳声
example: The shrill whistle of the train could be heard from miles away.
example_translation: 火车刺耳的汽笛声几英里外都能听到。

source_meaning: n. 摩天楼, 三角形天帆
example: The new skyscraper in the city center is over 300 meters tall and has 80 floors.
example_translation: 市中心的新摩天大楼高300多米，有80层。

source_meaning: n. 中伤, 诽谤；vt. 中伤, 诽谤
example: The celebrity sued the magazine for slander after it published false stories.
example_translation: 该名人因杂志发布虚假报道而起诉其诽谤。

source_meaning: n. 俚语；v. 辱骂, 用俚语说
example: The teacher explained that the word 'cool' is often used as slang in everyday conversation.
example_translation: 老师解释说，'cool'这个词在日常对话中常被用作俚语。

source_meaning: n. 睡眠, 麻木状态；vi. 微睡, 静止, 麻木；vt. 睡着度过(时间)
example: The baby fell into a deep slumber after being rocked gently for a few minutes.
example_translation: 婴儿被轻轻摇晃几分钟后进入了沉睡。

source_meaning: n. 冷笑, 嘲笑；vi. 嘲笑, 冷笑；vt. 嘲笑着说, 嘲笑得使
example: He gave a sneer of contempt when he heard the ridiculous excuse.
example_translation: 听到那个荒谬的借口时，他轻蔑地冷笑了一声。

source_meaning: n. 喷嚏；vi. 打喷嚏
example: She tried to suppress a sneeze during the quiet lecture, but it was impossible.
example_translation: 在安静的讲座中，她试图忍住喷嚏，但实在忍不住了。

collocations.meaning: 对……打喷嚏；轻视（常用于否定句）

source_meaning: a. 自命不凡的, 势利的
example: Her snobbish attitude made it difficult for her to make friends with ordinary people.
example_translation: 她自命不凡的态度使她很难与普通人交朋友。

source_meaning: n. 鼾声, 打鼾；vi. 打鼾；vt. 打鼾度过
example: My grandfather tends to snore loudly whenever he sleeps on his back.
example_translation: 我祖父仰卧睡觉时总是打鼾很响。

source_meaning: a. 悲伤的
example: The sorrowful melody of the violin brought tears to everyone's eyes.
example_translation: 小提琴悲伤的旋律让每个人眼中都涌出泪水。

source_meaning: n. 楼梯, 阶梯
example: The old building had a narrow stairway leading to the attic.
example_translation: 那座旧建筑有一条狭窄的楼梯通向阁楼。

collocations.meaning: 通往天堂的阶梯（歌曲名）

source_meaning: v. 口吃, 结结巴巴地说；n. 口吃, 结巴
example: He began to stammer nervously when the teacher asked him a difficult question.
example_translation: 当老师问他一个难题时，他紧张得开始结巴。

source_meaning: n. 文具, 信纸
example: She bought some beautiful stationery to write letters to her friends.
example_translation: 她买了一些漂亮的信纸给朋友写信。

source_meaning: n. 争吵, 竞争, 冲突
example: The country was torn apart by political strife and civil war.
example_translation: 这个国家被政治冲突和内战撕裂。

source_meaning: vt. 使服从, 压制, 减弱, 抑制, 克制
example: The police used tear gas to subdue the violent protesters.
example_translation: 警察使用催泪瓦斯制服了暴力抗议者。

word_family.meaning: subdued 的过去分词，也作形容词：被制服的，柔和的

source_meaning: a. 下标的, 写在底下的；n. 下标
example: In the chemical formula H2O, the number 2 is a subscript.
example_translation: 在化学式H2O中，数字2是下标。

source_meaning: a. 愠怒的, 沉闷的, 阴沉的
example: He remained sullen and refused to speak to anyone after the argument.
example_translation: 争吵后他闷闷不乐，拒绝和任何人说话。

source_meaning: n. 迷信
example: Many people believe that breaking a mirror brings bad luck, which is a common superstition.
example_translation: 许多人相信打碎镜子会带来厄运，这是一种常见的迷信。

source_meaning: n. 机智, 手法, 老练
example: She handled the delicate situation with great tact and diplomacy.
example_translation: 她以极大的机智和外交手腕处理了这个微妙的局面。

source_meaning: n. 带子操作工, 小蜡烛, 尖细, 渐弱, 锥形, 尖塔；a. 尖细的, 分等级的；v. (使)一头逐渐变细, (使)逐渐减少
example: The candle began to taper as it burned down, leaving a thin wick.
example_translation: 蜡烛燃烧时逐渐变细，留下细长的烛芯。

source_meaning: n. 焦油, 柏油, 水手；vt. 涂以焦油, 玷污, 怂恿；a. 焦油的
example: The workers spread hot tar on the road to repair the cracks.
example_translation: 工人们把热焦油铺在路上修补裂缝。

collocations.meaning: 涂焦油粘羽毛（一种私刑）

source_meaning: n. 定理, 原理
example: The Pythagorean theorem is one of the most famous in mathematics.
example_translation: 毕达哥拉斯定理是数学中最著名的定理之一。

source_meaning: a. 欠考虑的, 无深虑的, 轻率的
example: It was thoughtless of him to leave without saying goodbye to anyone.
example_translation: 他不跟任何人告别就离开，真是太欠考虑了。

source_meaning: vt. 打谷, 摔打, 反复研究, 推敲；vi. 打谷, 鞭打, 剧烈扭动
example: The farmers used a machine to thresh the wheat in the field.
example_translation: 农民们用机器在田里打麦子。

source_meaning: a. 累人的, 烦人的
example: The long meeting was tiresome, and everyone wanted to leave early.
example_translation: 漫长的会议令人厌烦，大家都想早点离开。

source_meaning: n. 蟾蜍, 癞蛤蟆, 讨厌的家伙
example: A toad hopped across the garden path after the rain.
example_translation: 雨后一只蟾蜍跳过了花园小径。

source_meaning: n. 使人痛苦的东西, 折磨者, 苦痛；vt. 使苦恼, 纠缠, 歪曲, 拷问
example: The memory of the accident continued to torment him for years.
example_translation: 事故的记忆多年来一直折磨着他。

source_meaning: n. 鱼雷, 水雷, 地雷；vt. 用鱼雷袭击, 破坏
example: The submarine launched a torpedo at the enemy ship.
example_translation: 潜艇向敌舰发射了一枚鱼雷。

source_meaning: n. 践踏(声), 蹂躏；v. 践踏, 无视
example: Please do not trample the flowers in the park.
example_translation: 请不要践踏公园里的花。

source_meaning: a. 安静的
example: The lake was tranquil in the early morning, reflecting the mountains.
example_translation: 清晨的湖面平静，倒映着群山。

source_meaning: n. 瞬, 短期居留者, 过境鸟, 瞬变现象；a. 短暂的, 易变的, 瞬变的, 路过的
example: The transient nature of fame means it can disappear quickly.
example_translation: 名声的短暂性意味着它可能很快消失。

source_meaning: n. 回归线
example: The ship sailed across the tropic of Cancer during its long voyage.
example_translation: 这艘船在漫长的航行中穿越了北回归线。

source_meaning: n. 郁金香
example: She planted tulip bulbs in the garden to bloom in spring.
example_translation: 她在花园里种了郁金香球茎，以便春天开花。

source_meaning: n. 超声波；a. 超音速的
example: Ultrasonic waves are used to clean delicate instruments.
example_translation: 超声波用于清洗精密仪器。

source_meaning: vt. 解开；vi. 松开
example: He tried to untie the knot in the rope but it was too tight.
example_translation: 他试图解开绳子上的结，但太紧了。

source_meaning: n. 骚动, 喧嚣
example: The announcement caused an uproar among the students.
example_translation: 这一宣布在学生中引起了骚动。

source_meaning: n. 器皿, 用具
example: She carefully washed every utensil after the dinner party.
example_translation: 晚宴后，她仔细清洗了每一件器皿。

source_meaning: a. 粘的, 粘性的
example: The viscous honey poured slowly from the jar.
example_translation: 粘稠的蜂蜜从罐子里慢慢倒出。

source_meaning: vt. 摇摆, 摇动, 饶舌；vi. 摆动, 喋喋不休；n. 摇摆, 爱说笑打趣的人
example: The dog began to wag its tail when it saw its owner.
example_translation: 狗看到主人时开始摇尾巴。

source_meaning: a. 注意的, 警戒的, 警醒的, (时间)醒着换过的
example: The watchful guard noticed the suspicious movement at the gate.
example_translation: 警觉的警卫注意到门口的可疑动静。

source_meaning: a. 水的, 湿的, 平淡的, 稀薄的, 水淋淋的
example: The soup was too watery because too much water was added.
example_translation: 汤太稀了，因为加了太多水。

source_meaning: n. 码头；vt. 卸在码头上, 靠码头；vi. 靠码头, 入坞
example: The cargo was unloaded from the ship onto the wharf.
example_translation: 货物从船上卸到码头上。

source_meaning: n. 腮须, 胡须, 一丝儿
example: The cat's whisker twitched as it sensed the mouse nearby in the dark kitchen.
example_translation: 猫的胡须抽动了一下，因为它感觉到黑暗的厨房里有老鼠。

collocations.meaning: 猫的胡须；了不起的人或事物

source_meaning: a. 有益健康的, 合乎卫生的, 健全的, 有益的, 有生气的, 审慎的
example: Eating a wholesome breakfast every morning gives you energy for the whole day.
example_translation: 每天早上吃一顿健康的早餐能让你一整天都精力充沛。

source_meaning: a. 任性的, 固执的, 故意的, 存心的
example: His wilful refusal to follow the safety rules caused a serious accident in the factory.
example_translation: 他固执地拒绝遵守安全规则，导致工厂发生严重事故。

source_meaning: n. 风车
example: The old windmill on the hill still turns slowly in the summer breeze.
example_translation: 山上的老风车在夏日的微风中仍然缓慢转动。

source_meaning: n. 啄木鸟
example: A woodpecker tapped rhythmically on the trunk of the old oak tree.
example_translation: 一只啄木鸟在老橡树的树干上有节奏地啄着。

source_meaning: n. 扳钳, 扳手, 扭伤, 歪曲, 痛苦；vt. 猛扭, 扭伤, 曲解, 折磨；vi. 猛扭, 猛绞
example: He used a wrench to tighten the loose bolt on the bicycle frame.
example_translation: 他用扳手拧紧了自行车车架上松动的螺栓。

source_meaning: n. 酵母
example: Add a little yeast to the dough and let it rise for an hour.
example_translation: 在面团里加一点酵母，让它发酵一个小时。

source_meaning: a. 生产的, 屈从的, 柔顺的, 易弯曲的
example: The yielding branches of the willow tree bent gracefully in the strong wind.
example_translation: 柳树柔软的枝条在强风中优雅地弯曲。

source_meaning: n. 轭, 牛轭, 束缚；vt. 给...上轭, 连接, 结合, 使匹配；vi. 结合, 匹配
example: The farmer placed a wooden yoke on the oxen to pull the heavy plow.
example_translation: 农夫给牛套上木轭，让它们拉沉重的犁。

source_meaning: n. 蛋黄, 卵黄
example: The bright yellow yolk of the fresh egg made the dish look more appetizing.
example_translation: 新鲜鸡蛋的亮黄色蛋黄让这道菜看起来更诱人。

source_meaning: n. 锌；vt. 镀锌于
example: Zinc is an essential mineral that helps the body fight off infections.
example_translation: 锌是一种必需的矿物质，有助于身体抵抗感染。

source_meaning: n. 用兵学, 战术, 兵法
example: The coach changed his tactics in the second half to secure a narrow victory.
example_translation: 教练在下半场改变了战术，以确保险胜。
